plugins.readme_text:
# DSH界面美化 · DSH UI Beautify **语言 / Languages:** 中文（本页） ｜ **English**（点击下方「English version」展开） > 给 DSH 页面加壁纸与毛玻璃。项目名 **DSH UI Beautify**：包名 `dsh-ui-beautify`，路由 `/dsh-ui-beautify/*`，全局 `__DSHUI__`，存储键 `__dshui.*`。 > 原包名 `dsh-dsniang-beautify` 的旧存档会自动迁移；旧 hash（`#dsniang-off` / `#dsniang-diag`）与旧 URL 参数（`?dsniang=`）仍兼容。 > 仓库：`Rad-Weed/DSH-UI-Beautify`（私有） **版本：v0.8.5** · 给 DSH 页面加壁纸与毛玻璃。 > ⚠️ **v0.1 出过事故**：它会改目标面板的 `position` / `overflow`，导致界面布局坍塌、 > 基本无法操作。v0.2 从设计上取消了所有这类改动，详见下面「为什么 v0.2 不会再弄坏界面」。 ---
English version（点击展开 / Click to expand） # English version **DSH UI Beautify** — a wallpaper + frosted-glass beautifier for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) desktop client. Package `dsh-ui-beautify` · routes `/dsh-ui-beautify/*` · global API `__DSHUI__` · storage keys `__dshui.*`. Settings stored under the old package name (`dsh-dsniang-beautify`) are migrated automatically; the legacy hashes `#dsniang-off` / `#dsniang-diag` and the legacy URL parameter `?dsniang=` still work. Repository: `Rad-Weed/DSH-UI-Beautify`. > This is the English manual. The Chinese manual above is the full one (troubleshooting, internals, release tooling). ## What it does - **Three modes**: **Off** (factory default — touches nothing) / **Texture** (multiply blending; the wallpaper is tinted into the UI) / **Backdrop** (the image is truly behind the content, with a scrim slider). - **Real frosted glass** (`backdrop-filter`): composer card, user bubbles, DSH dialogs and menus, the whale-widget panel, and — in Backdrop mode — code blocks and attachment cards in the chat. All share one parameter set. - **Two wallpapers**: drop `deepseek 4k.png` / `deepseek 黑白无水面.png` on your Desktop and those are used; otherwise the bundled WebP fallbacks are used (you always have two options on any machine). Switching is a cross-fade (no blank frame). - **Click the background** → fades to the default background (420 ms), then restores the wallpaper after **2 s**. - Clicking bubbles, the composer, buttons, links or icons is **never intercepted**. - **Built-in diagnostics** (`Ctrl+Shift+Alt+I`): mode, wallpaper source and health, glass state, frame rate — no DevTools required. - **Motion**: the shared foundation is in place (master switch **off** by default); decorative animations are deliberately left for later. ## Three buttons | Button | Effect | Does it touch the page layout? | |---|---|---| | **Off** (default) | Everything restored; nothing is mounted | No | | **Texture** | Multiply wallpaper (default concentration 0.49) + frosted glass (with "clearing" of the composer seat's own scrim) | Adds our own layers, a class toggle, and clears background colors (byte-exact restore) | | **Backdrop** | The image really sits behind everything (`z-index:-1`), with theme-aware scrim; the shell's full-screen opaque background is overridden by a class toggle; frosted glass works here too | Only our own layers + one class-toggle rule | ## Factory defaults | Item | Default | Stored in | |---|---|---| | Startup mode | **Off** | `localStorage['__dshui.mode']` | | Texture concentration | **0.49** | `localStorage['__dshui.opacities']` | | Backdrop concentration | **0.5** | same | | Scrim strength | 0 (slider 0–90%, 1% steps) | `localStorage['__dshui.scrim']` | | Wallpaper | **`deepseek 4k.png`** (shown as `deepseek`) | `localStorage['__dshui.image']` | | Frosted glass | **on** | `localStorage['__dshui.frost.v3']` | | Glass blur / white layer | **2 px / 20%**（径向渐变：内部更透） | same | | Panel white layer (edge / center) | **94% / 80%**（径向渐变） | same | | Bubble transparency / color / blur | **45% / original color / 12 px** | same | | DSH panel blur | **20 px** | same | | Motion | **off** (master switch; `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+M`) | `localStorage['__dshui.motion.v1']` | | Startup splash | **on** (Rhine-Lab-style loading animation; panel toggle, `?splash=0` or `prefers-reduced-motion` skips it) | `localStorage['__dshui.splash.v1']` | | Pill position | `10, 10` (top-left) | `localStorage['__dshui.pill']` | Defaults apply only when nothing is stored yet; once you move a slider, the stored value wins. ## Install 1. Extract `dsh-ui-beautify-0.8.5.zip` → you get a `dsh-ui-beautify/` directory (`package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` / `lib` / `assets` (both fallback images) / `test` / `scripts/uninstall-cleanup.ps1` / `README.md` / `HANDOFF.md` / `LICENSE` — 13 entries); 2. Put it somewhere that won't be deleted (an ASCII-only path is recommended); 3. Install it through the official plugin channel with the extracted directory as `target`: `pluginManager.installBundle('file:D:\\dsh-plugins\\dsh-ui-beautify')` (same as `dsh plugin add file:...`); 4. **Restart the DSH client** (the bundle stack is collected once at startup); 5. Self-check: `node test/host.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs` inside the extracted directory — all green. The official channel registers three things (all of them are needed, otherwise the plugin manager treats the bundle as a stray entry): the `node_modules/dsh-ui-beautify` junction, the profile `package.json` `dsh.profile.bundles` + `dependencies`, and the `pnpm-lock.yaml` importer record. ## Uninstall 1. **Quickest** (no restart): `__DSHUI__.setMode('off')`, or open `...#dshui-off` and reload; 2. **Proper**: Settings → Plugins → `dsh-ui-beautify` → Uninstall (or `pluginManager.removeBundle('dsh-ui-beautify')`); 3. **Manual fallback**: `.rollback/` holds a copy of the pre-install profile config; restore it, remove the junction with `cmd /c rmdir "\node_modules\dsh-ui-beautify"` (links only), then restart DSH. After uninstalling, `scripts/uninstall-cleanup.ps1` runs the post-uninstall self-check: it asserts the "four-piece" state (`package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `node_modules/.modules.yaml`, `cordis.yml`) and removes a leftover `node_modules` junction (link only, never the target). Idempotent, supports `-DryRun`, writes a log, exit codes `0/1/2/3/4`. ## External side effects Pure Cordis plugin: it does **not** modify `app.asar`, the registry, scheduled tasks, environment variables or ports; no daemon, no child processes, no external network requests. Only six read-only loopback routes (`/dsh-ui-beautify/*`). Runtime changes are limited to our own DOM nodes, class toggles and CSS variables, all restored byte-exactly on teardown. The startup splash is a **same-origin iframe**; it is removed entirely when it finishes (or is skipped / times out) and never touches the host page CSS. ### User data All settings live in `localStorage` under `__dshui.*` (mode, opacities, scrim, frost, motion, splash, pill, image). Uninstalling **keeps** them by default. To wipe: ```js Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k => k.startsWith('__dshui.')).forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k)) ``` ## Diagnostics - Panel: `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+I` (or open `...#dshui-diag` and reload). - HTTP: `/dsh-ui-beautify/status.json` (wallpaper resolution) and `/dsh-ui-beautify/diag.json` (last report). - Console API: `__DSHUI__.status()` / `.wallpaper()` / `.reapply()` / `.uninstall()` / `.setMode('off'|'multiply'|'backdrop')`. ## Motion The motion foundation (master switch, `prefers-reduced-motion`, pause on blur) and the `requestAnimationFrame` frame-time probe are in place. Motion is **off** by default; `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+M` toggles it. All future animations must go through `motionAllowed()`. ## Startup splash On page load a **Rhine-Lab-style** startup sequence plays (black identity act → over-exposed wash → technical HUD → six authorization steps → white-flash cut into the session), then fades out and removes itself with zero residue. It is independent of the mode: it plays by default whenever the plugin is installed. - **When it plays**: on by default; skipped automatically under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, with `#dshui-off` (emergency switch), or `?splash=0`; `?splash=1` forces it on for debugging. - **Panel**: an "开屏动画：开/关" toggle (persisted to `__dshui.splash.v1`) plus "↻ 重播" to preview it anytime. - **Console API**: `__DSHUI__.splash.replay()` / `.skip()` / `.setEnabled(true|false)` / `.config()`. - **Isolation**: the splash is a **same-or

# 设计与代码的建模/自动化审查（dsh-model-everything）

English · 中文

把设计与代码里的断言抽象成模型，交给引擎跑一遍：结论带出处与哈希，能复算、能比对。让结论来自一次运行，而不是一次通盘推理：把「想清楚」变成「跑一遍」。 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件。把设计与代码里**关于行为的断言**变成可运行、可审查、可导出的模型： - **核验断言**：逐条对着源码检查，引用到 `file:line`。 - **跑模型**：状态机、协议、多机协作、数据模型先建成可执行模型，再交给引擎跑。 - **审图**：UML 图按模型读、按模型审，并与模型对照。 - **对照重构**：重构前后各建一份模型，两份报告摆一起比。 - **留痕**：结论固化成带哈希的报告，可复算、可比对、可导出。 ## 能力范围 | 域 | 做什么 | |---|---| | 事实核验 | 把一份设计/规格/评审意见里的可验证断言列出来，逐条对着代码核验并给出出处。核不了的直接说明 | | 行为验证 | 状态机与协议：结构检查、对抗性探测、预算与时限、before/after 回归。多机组合查死锁，以及永不发生的会合（握手事件） | | 图 | UML 2.5 各图族的渲染、解析与建模审查（含 render→parse 往返一致性对照），覆盖 Mermaid 与 PlantUML 两种记号 | | 结构 | 组件/包/类/部署图按依赖图审计：孤立节点、悬空引用、环、矩阵与分层违规、缺失的必需边 | | 数据 | 数据模型与迁移：结构、迁移覆盖、拷贝一致性、回滚对称、前后数据回归 | | 并发 / 同步 / 异步 | 挖掘"工作怎么被执行"的断言（线程安全、锁、中断、async/await、事件循环…）并路由到能判定它的工具；它自己不证明 | | 导出 | 已验证模型导出为 UPPAAL / TLA+ / PRISM / SPIN 的输入 | | 报告 | 报告正文渲染、基线比对（`report_diff`）、哈希规范 | ## 典型用法 ### 重构 harness 重构可以改实现，不能改行为。这个判断交给引擎，不必通读 diff： 1. **重构前**：从当前代码抽出 BEFORE 模型（`uml_parse` 读已有的图，或按 schema 手写）。 2. **重构**。 3. **重构后**：抽出 AFTER 模型。 4. **回归**：`model_verify` 带 `beforeModel` 与 `stateMapping` 跑前后回归：行为是否保持、不变式是否连续、状态映射是否自洽。数据侧用 `model_datamodel_verify` 的 `beforeModel` / `fieldMapping` / `migrationMappings` 做同一件事的**数据版**。 5. **判定与留痕**：`report_diff` 拿基线报告比对。新增的 error 发现，就是这次重构不接受的理由。报告里的哈希让结论可复算。 它比较的是**你给的两份模型**，不是两份代码。每份模型是否忠实于对应代码，由第 1、3 步负责，它不代替你做。它也不读 diff、不改代码、不跑你的测试。它回答的是"行为还一样吗"，不是"重构得好不好"。 ### 代码流程审查 先把分支逻辑画成流程，再看这张图到底说了什么： 1. **抽流程**：把函数或服务里的分支写成 `LogicModelV1`，或者手画一张 `stateDiagram-v2` / PlantUML 图。 2. **读回模型**：手画的图交给 `uml_parse` 转成模型。读不动的行会变成警告，不会悄悄跳过。 3. **审查**：`uml_review` 报结构缺陷——不可达状态、死端、分支有歧义或没穷尽、自环没有出口、孤立节点、环——以及文档缺口。 4. **落回源码**：每条发现都回到代码核验。图画对了，不等于代码写对了。 它审的是你给的那张图和那份模型。图与代码是否一致，由第 1 步的抽取负责。 ### 状态机审查 把状态机建成可执行模型，让引擎去跑，而不是通读代码判断它会不会卡死： 1. **建模型**：手画的 `stateDiagram-v2` 或 PlantUML 状态图交给 `uml_parse`；也可以直接按 schema 写 `LogicModelV1`。 2. **跑检查**：`model_verify` 找的是不可达状态、吸收环、被静默忽略的事件、没有恢复路径的资源申请、预算超限，以及无法满足的时限。每一项都作为一个**带码**的发现报出，而码的前缀说明它属于哪一族。 3. **写清"永远/绝不"**：把这类断言写进 `invariants`，引擎会在全部可达状态上搜反例，并给出它找到的最短路径。 4. **落回源码**：报告里的 error 发现逐条回到代码。 并发断言分两半：**两个模型都碰同一个共享位置**这一类，由我们自己的 `model_compose_verify` 判（声明 `shared` 与 `accesses` 之后的 C3/C4/C5，包括丢更新）；源码级数据竞争、中断延迟、阻塞调用与漏掉的 `await` 仍路由到 TSan/Helgrind/CBMC/TLA+。硬实时语义（deadline、period）不在它的范围内。 ### 审计一张依赖图 组件图是关于「哪些模块可以依赖哪些」的断言。把它当图读，再问那些边是否被允许： 1. **给图**：PlantUML 的组件/包/类/部署图源码，或 Mermaid 类图。`uml_structure_verify` 把它解析成节点与边。 2. **说清什么被允许**（如果有规则）：一个含 `layers` 与 `rules` 的矩阵，每条规则点名一个 `source` 并给 `allow` / `deny` / `require`，再用 `default` 管其余。没有矩阵时，它只报结构缺陷。 3. **读发现**：孤立节点、从未声明过的端点、带最短路径的环、越过层的边、缺失的必需边，以及——一个节点都没声明时——**这份输入没有任何可审的东西**。 4. **换一种图就换个工具**：如果这张图是状态图或活动图，那是 `uml_review`，不是它。 它审的是**图**，不是代码。一张自洽的图仍可能画错了系统，所以要和源码侧扫描配对。手画的图报「标签漂移」时，`uml_explain_labels` 会打印该记号下解析器接受的标签写法。 ### 让设计对自己作出的声明负责 设计会对自己作出断言：这一层在那层之上、这个组件拥有那条依赖、这个接口比它的调用方窄。`model_design_review` 判定设计是否守住了这些承诺： 1. **把设计写成模型**：架构（节点与边），加上它声明的——分层、边界、允许与必需的边、带职责的类型、操作、转移、父类型。 2. **跑它**：`model_design_review` 报出设计与自相矛盾的地方，并**另外**报出它图的形状——环与打断环所需的最少边、承重元素、层级、扇入扇出。 3. **读那三个列表**：`violations` 决定判定；`signals` 值得一看但不使任何东西失败；`facts` 是**测量**，不是发现。`checksSkipped` 说明哪些原则因为**没声明任何可对照的东西**而没有检查。 **它从不按外部标准评判设计。** 它报的是：设计**与它自己声明的某件事**矛盾，或关于它的图的一个结构事实。问「这个设计好不好」是评审者的问题；这个工具回答的是另一个：**它就自己的说法而言，站得住吗**。 ### 两台必须互相配合的机器 一台机器**不会因为另一台**而死锁。当两个组件握手时，真正有意思的失败在**组合**里： 1. **各自建模**，然后一起给：`model_compose_verify` 收一个模型数组。 2. **点名共享事件**：如果一个握手只有在双方都就绪时才合法，把它写进 `rendezvous`。没写进去的事件只推进一台机器，所以等握手的机器可以先走任意多步自己的路。 3. **读 C1 与 C2**：一个可达节点上没有任何机器能前进、且有机器不是终止态（C1），以及一个**永远不会触发**的会合（C2）。两者都逐机给出理由，C1 还给最短反例。 模型里**没有速率比，也没有公平性约束**。单台机器自己的问题——不可达状态、不变式、成本对预算——用 `model_verify`。 ### 并发声明：挖掘并路由 「线程安全」「lock-free」「ISR 安全」都是需要某个能判定它们的工具的断言，而第一步是**把它们找出来**： 1. **扫文本**：`model_interleaving_scan` 收文档、计划或笔记，报出风险点——那条声明、共享状态、中断、临界区，以及异步的那些（`async`、`await`、`promise`、事件循环、回调）。每条发现都带 `family`（threads / synchronization / async / interrupts / shared-state），绝对式断言按 error 报。 2. **看每条绝对声明欠着什么**：「不可能有数据竞争」这类声明会被报为 error，要求**专门的**验证，且每条发现都点名能判定它的分析——竞争用 TSan 或 Helgrind，有界证明用 CBMC，协议用 TLA+，中断用 RTOS 感知的分析。 3. **去做那个分析**：本插件不运行它，也不对并发安全作任何证明。 它读的是**文本**。它看不见你的线程，而**一次干净的扫描不是健康证明**——它的含义是没找到声明，这是另一个命题。 ### 一次迁移：前后两份模型 迁移是两份模型，加一个「数据活下来了」的断言。把两份都给出去，这个断言就变成可核查的： 1. **两份模型**：改动前的 schema 与改动后的 schema，各自是含实体、字段、键与关系的数据模型。 2. **说清字段怎么走**：`fieldMapping` 从旧路径到新路径，加上 `migrationMappings`——用于来源不是它自己旧名字的字段。 3. **跑比对**：`model_datamodel_verify` 带 `beforeModel`，检查迁移覆盖、拷贝一致性、回滚对称，以及前后数据回归。 4. **读那条警告**：新 schema 里声明为 `required`、却没有任何东西供给它的字段，会报 `DS2_REQUIRED_FIELD_UNSOURCED`。它是 **warning**，所以判定停在 `pass_with_findings`——**这是一个要做的决定，不是引擎可以替你宣布的失败**。 它比较的是**你给的两份模型**。任一份是否忠实于它所描述的数据库，是抽取那一步的事，这个工具不做。 ### 图的导入与导出：设计冻结与长期迭代 这里存的是**源文件**，不是截图：`uml_render` 写出 Mermaid / PlantUML 源，`uml_parse` 把源读回模型。一份图因此能当两种东西用： - **设计冻结的留档**：把图源、模型和那一次的验证报告一起提交进仓库，作为某个时间点的设计记录。模型里可以放 `_` 前缀的元数据（单据号、日期、负责人、抽取时留下的保留意见），这些键不参与哈希，补档案信息不会改变结论的身份。 - **长期迭代的参考**：下一次改动时重新抽出模型、重跑验证，再用 `report_diff` 与冻结的那份报告比对。新增的 error 是这次改动引入的，消失的说明旧问题已经解决；哈希让"还是不是同一份模型"可判定，不必肉眼比图。 需要交给外部检查器时，同一份模型可以用 `model_export` 导出成 UPPAAL / TLA+ / PRISM / SPIN 的原生输入。 界线：它保存并比对的是**模型与图的源文件**，渲染出来的图片只是副产品。图变了模型没变、或模型变了图没变，都会在下一次解析或比对时暴露。 ## 工具 | 工具 | 做什么 | |---|---| | `uml_render` | 模型 → 图源（Mermaid / PlantUML），可指定图族。记号表达不了的视图会被拒绝，并说明理由 | | `uml_parse` | 图源 → 该图族的模型；不属于状态机/流程的族会按名拒绝，而不是硬当作状态机解析 | | `uml_review` | 审查建模：结构缺陷、文档缺口、render↔parse 往返一致性；给模型、给图，或两者对照 | | `uml_explain_labels` | 打印解析器接受的标签与注释契约，不需要图 | | `model_verify` | 状态机 / 协议的可执行验证（结构检查、对抗性探测、预算、时限、前后回归） | | `model_compose_verify` | 两台及以上机器的组合检查（死锁、永不发生的会合；声明了共享位置后还有无序写 C4 与非原子更新 C5） | | `model_datamodel_verify` | 数据模型与迁移验证 | | `model_interleaving_scan` | 并发 / 同步 / 异步声明的挖掘与路由 | | `model_export` | 导出到外部检查器（UPPAAL / TLA+ / PRISM / SPIN） | | `uml_structure_verify` | 依赖图审计（含依赖矩阵与多层级细化） | | `model_design_review` | 设计审阅：依赖图形状 + 设计自身声明的契约（分层、职责边界、可替换性、接口宽度） | | `report_diff` | 两份报告比对：新增/消失/变化的发现 | `model_verify`、`model_datamodel_verify`、`model_design_review` 另收 `modelPath`：从工作区里的 JSON 文件读模型，缩进、BOM、尾随换行都不影响。它与内联的 `model` 二选一，两个都给会被拒绝。 ## 怎么读报告 工具的产出是一份报告，结论只在 `verdict` 里：**看 `verdict`，不看 `ok`**。`ok` 在各族的含义不同——多数族在评审失败时仍是 `true`，组合族在出现 error 级发现时是 `false`——所以它不能当判定读；把它当判定读，会得出与报告相反的结论。 | 字段 | 说明 | |---|---| | `verdict` | 判定：`pass`、`pass_with_findings`、`fail` | | `verdictReason` | 一句话说明为什么是这个判定 | | `hashes` | `hashSpec` 与 `modelHash`；前后回归另带 `beforeModelHash`、`afterModelHash`。同一份模型永远得到同一个哈希 | | `nextSteps` | 引擎建议的下一步 | | `schema` | 报告的版本化契约，例如 `model-everything/verify/v1`。要按字段分支，就分支在它上面 | | `truncated` | 搜索撞到上限就停了。**截断不等于通过**，是没结论；某个性质没判定出来时，报告里会出现 `_UNDECIDED` | 默认返回正文。被截断的检查可以单独展开：传 `check: ""`，该检查的全部条目都会打印。要完整结果，传 `reportView: "full"`——紧凑 JSON，对象不丢字段。 `ok` 为 `false` 时判定也是 `fail`，但含义不同：工具根本没跑。原因写在 `errorCode` 里——输入不合法、图族不支持，或声明的 `intent` 服务不了。这类拒绝的 `verdictReason` 以 `the tool did not run:` 开头。 报告怎么读，有一份成体系的说明：[`skills/model-everything-report-reading/`](skills/model-everything-report-reading/) 讲阅读顺序（先看跑没跑、再看判了什么、最后看该做什么）、发现分别放在哪一层、以及两处最容易读反的地方。结构由一个**从真实报告生成的思维导图**给出：[`docs/report-reading/mindmap.mmd`](docs/report-reading/mindmap.mmd)，`tests/report-reading` 会在图与引擎不一致时失败。 `uml_render`、`uml_parse`、`uml_review` 另收一个 `intent`，用来说明这份产物要做什么：给人看（`present`）、要被验证引擎读回（`verify`）、还是要证明渲染与模型一致（`fidelity`）。服务不了这个用途的视图会被直接拒绝，而不是勉强画出来。 ## 示例 `examples/` 里是可以直接跑的样本模型，配 [`examples/README.md`](examples/README.md) 说明各自的看点和预期结果。它们是文档，不是测试夹具——各测试套件读自己的 `tests/<套件>/fixtures/`： - `examples/order-state-machine.before.json` 与 `examples/order-state-machine.after.json`：订单流程的前后两份模型，用来跑前后回归。 - `examples/control-dispatcher.json`：带预算与锁配对的分发状态机，预期零错误。 -

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 常驻余额胶囊：右下角一眼看到 DeepSeek 账户余额，不碰凭据、不需要 API Key。A tiny resident balance pill for the DSH Web UI.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-balance-pill

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%E2%89%A50.2.0--rc.2-blue)](package.json)
[![size](https://img.shields.io/badge/size-12%20KB-lightgrey)](client.js)

**DeepSeek Harness 常驻余额胶囊** —— 右下角一眼看到你的 DeepSeek 账户余额，不用再点开设置。

> A tiny resident balance pill for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI.
> ~12 KB of plain JavaScript, **no HTTP endpoints of its own, no credentials touched, no API key needed**.

---



## 它长什么样

界面右下角一个圆角小胶囊：

```
● 余额 ¥12.34
```

- 鼠标悬停 → 显示赠送额度、更新时间、刷新说明
- 点击 → 立刻刷新
- 每 60 秒自动刷新，**只在页面可见时计时**；切回页面或窗口重新获得焦点时立刻补一次
- 亮/暗主题自动跟随，中英文跟随界面语言

| 状态 | 外观 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| 正常 | 绿点 + `余额 ¥12.34` | 读到充值钱包余额 |
| 加载中 | 灰点 + `余额 --` | 正在读取 |
| 未登录 | 灰点 + `余额 --` | 当前用 API Key，没有平台账户凭据 |
| 读取失败 | 橙点 + `余额 --` | 平台请求失败；悬停显示原因 |
| 异常 | 红点 + `余额 --` | 调用本身出错；悬停显示错误信息 |

## 快速开始

**官方桌面端** —— 侧栏 → **Plugins（插件）** → 安装 → 填：

```
github:fdghdfghdfghd/dsh-balance-pill
```

装完如果没出现，**完全退出客户端（含托盘）再打开**。

**`dsh web` / 其他 profile**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:fdghdfghdfghd/dsh-balance-pill
```

装完重启 `dsh web`，浏览器 `Ctrl+F5`。

## 安装细节

### 官方桌面端（Electron 客户端）

桌面端读的是 **`desktop` profile**，而 `dsh plugin --profile desktop …` 这条命令**按设计会被 CLI 拒绝**——它归应用的插件管理器管。所以只能走应用内的 Plugins 页面，不能照抄下面的 `--profile web` 命令。

### 本地开发

```sh
git clone https://github.com/fdghdfghdfghd/dsh-balance-pill.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:D:\path\to\dsh-balance-pill
```

`link:` 是软链安装，改源码立即生效（前端改动刷新页面即可）；**之后不要移动该目录**，移动了要重新 `add` 一次。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-balance-pill
```

桌面端在 **Plugins 页面**里点卸载。

## 它是怎么工作的

余额**不是**自己去请求平台接口，而是复用宿主已经挂载的 `account` Remote 命名空间：

```js
ctx.remote.account.getBalance({ version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds })
```

这和「设置 → 账户 → 余额」卡片调用的是**同一个宿主方法**。因此：

- **浏览器永远拿不到 token** —— 凭据、平台地址、请求头、超时、失效处理全部留在宿主侧；
- 插件不碰账号逻辑，也不需要你配置任何 API Key；
- 未登录（只用 API Key）时该方法返回 `null`，胶囊显示为「未登录」。

金额格式与官方账户卡片对齐：两位小数、千位分组、正的次分金额显示为 `<¥0.01`。

### 结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向补丁；`dsh.client` 声明浏览器半边 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 只插入一行宿主条目 |
| `index.js` | 宿主半边，空实现 —— 它的唯一作用是让 Loader 有一行条目，浏览器模块系统据此发现 `dsh.client` 声明 |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半边：注册进 `shell.overlay` 浮层并渲染胶囊 |

界面文案走 Client locale 服务（命名空间 `dsh-balance-pill`，`zh` / `en`）；配色只使用宿主主题令牌（`--dsw-alias-*`），因此亮暗主题自动跟随；控件自己打开 `pointer-events`，浮层其余部分保持点击穿透。

## 常见问题

**装完右下角什么都没有？**
依次查三处：① 装到了哪个 profile —— 桌面端必须是 `desktop`，用 `--profile web` 装的东西桌面端读不到；② `dsh.profile.bundles` 里有没有 `dsh-balance-pill`；③ 完全退出客户端再打开（热加载对首次安装不总是够）。

**一直显示「未登录」？**
说明宿主里没有平台账户凭据。去「设置 → 账号」登录 DeepSeek 账号；只用 API Key 是不会走到账户余额接口的。

**和别的挂件打架？**
它固定占据右下角 16px 处。先看看有没有其他插件（比如桌宠类）也占这块；要挪位置就改 `client.js` 里按钮的 `right` / `bottom`。

**刷新太频繁 / 太懒？**
改 `client.js` 里的 `REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS`（默认 60000 毫秒）。

**会消耗我的 API 额度吗？**
不会。它读的是账户余额，一次 `GET` 快照，不发起任何模型请求。

## 兼容性

- 在 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2（Windows 桌面端）** 上实测可用；
- 只在**浏览器半边**生效（`dsh.client.platform = web`），需要宿主挂载了 `account` Remote（桌面端 / 登录了 DeepSeek 账号的 Web 端）。没有该命名空间时插件会安静地不激活，不会报错。

## 已知限制

- **只显示余额**，不做记账、不算每轮消耗。想要「今天花了多少 / 每轮花了多少 / 多厂商额度」，用 [dsh-whale-widget](https://github.com/MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget) 这类完整桌宠记账插件更合适 —— 这个胶囊解决的是「一眼看到」。
- 位置固定在右下角，没有设置界面（改常量即可）。
- 没有单元测试。验证方式见下 —— 是「宿主是否真的把这个 bundle 编进了启动图」，而不是「代码看着没问题」。

## 开发与验证

改刷新间隔：`client.js` 里的 `REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS`。
改文案：同文件的 `COPY`。

验证插件真的被宿主加载了（而不是只躺在 `node_modules` 里）：DSH 的 `/plugins` 路由**只按精确的 `id + rev`** 响应，`rev` 由 bundle 的 `mtimeMs/ctimeMs/size` 派生：

```sh
curl "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/plugins/??dsh-balance-pill/client.js&rev=<rev>"
```

返回 `200` 且响应体含 `__ModuleLoader__` 即说明：Loader 条目已启用、`dsh.client` 声明合法、bundle 已编入启动图。错 `rev` 或错 id 必须 `404` —— 拿这个做反向对照，否则容易把「服务器对什么都答 200」误判成成功。

## 变更记录

见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## License

MIT —— 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。图标由脚本生成，随项目一并按 MIT 发布。

---

## English

A ~12 KB resident widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that shows your DeepSeek **account balance** in the bottom-right corner.

- Registers a React component into the `shell.overlay` slot; follows theme tokens and the client locale service.
- Reads the balance through the host's existing `account` Remote (`getBalance`) — **the browser never receives a token**, and no API key is required.
- Refreshes every 60 s while the page is visible, on click, and when the window regains focus.
- Install: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:fdghdfghdfghd/dsh-balance-pill` (on the official desktop app, use the in-app **Plugins** page instead — the `desktop` profile belongs to the app's plugin manager).

MIT licensed. It only *displays* the balance; for per-turn cost accounting and multi-vendor quotas, use a full desktop-pet accounting plugin instead.

plugins.description: Second-opinion review for DeepSeek Harness sessions: a restricted child session re-reads the Executor's work with read-only tools and delivers severity-ranked advice.
plugins.readme_text:
# @wweir/dsh-advisor

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

An automatic second opinion for DeepSeek Harness sessions.

On a configurable step rhythm, a **restricted sub-agent** re-reads the
Executor's recent work with read-only tools. Concrete defects are recorded and
delivered to the Executor's inbox; when there is nothing to point at, the
reviewer stays silent — silence is the normal outcome, not a failure.

The plugin never runs its own model loop: the review is a real child session,
so the host's turn/step machine, tool pipeline, streaming, cancellation and
persistence apply to it unchanged.

## What it does for you

- **Catches hallucinations.** The reviewer reads the actual files (read-only):
  changes claimed but not made, APIs that do not exist, values never written.
  The note points at the mismatch while the work is fresh; delivery is
  advisory, interrupting only as configured.
- **Keeps sessions on track.** At most one review every N completed steps
  (default 8), never concurrently — a step boundary that arrives mid-review
  waits for the next cadence instead of stacking reviews. A step is one model
  call plus its tools, so one cadence covers work inside a long turn and work
  spread across many short turns; `everySteps: 0` turns automatic review off.
  Drift is reported inside the running turn; idle sessions can be woken by
  severe findings (budgeted, severity-gated). Silence is reported as a result,
  not an error.
- **Bounded cost.** The reviewer's context is a compiled two-zone projection,
  never a copy of the Executor's. The prompt is capped by the operator's
  `maxContextTokens` (64K by default) **and** by the reviewer model's own
  window: the host preamble, the model's output reserve and a margin are
  subtracted first, and a route that cannot hold even a minimal review is
  refused with those numbers instead of overflowing into a host compaction.
  The check is as good as the route's advertisement: a route that does not
  report a window keeps the operator's cap, because that is the only number the
  plugin has.
  The zone after the boundary carries the work since the last review that
  concluded (a silent or finding outcome), with its evidence graded by whether
  the reviewer could re-obtain it: the Executor's visible claims travel, a tool
  call keeps its name and arguments (shell commands capped at 600 characters,
  edits at 2,000), a file read or search the reviewer can repeat becomes its
  path and size, a shell result its status, a few failure lines and the tail,
  and every other result — an edit, a tool error, `ls`, an MCP server, a
  subagent, a job — keeps its text. Every message line is capped at 4,000
  characters. The zone before the boundary is a trace of
  already-reviewed work, with tool-result bodies omitted — and the prompt says
  so, because omitted must not read as unexecuted. The Executor's reasoning is
  dropped: it is intent, not evidence. Earlier reviews' conclusions travel as a
  bounded block, so the reviewer does not re-investigate work already judged.
  The boundary line carries a nonce minted per review, so a phrase quoted inside
  the evidence cannot pose as it. A stable instruction prefix lets the provider
  cache hit across reviews (cache-read tokens are shown in the tab and billed
  at cache rates). Output is a single advice of at most 2K characters.

## Why

Most advisor plugins hand the transcript to one extra LLM call and inject
whatever comes back. This plugin makes the reviewer a **real child session with
its own read-only tools**, which buys four concrete things:

- **It verifies instead of guessing.** The reviewer opens the files the
  Executor actually touched, so a note points at a defect it looked at — not
  a pattern inferred from a transcript summary, which is all a
  transcript-only reviewer can ever offer.
- **The host's rules apply to the review itself.** Turn/step accounting, the
  tool pipeline, streaming, cancellation, persistence, and a real audit
  trail: the review is a session you can inspect, and its cost is reported
  usage, not an estimate.
- **Isolation is enforced, not promised.** One reviewer claim per process, a
  read-only tool surface, a protected-path guard deliberately stricter than
  the upstream advisor (workspace-root private keys and `.envrc` included),
  and no shared context with the Executor.
- **Delivery is accounted.** A **follow-up** note counts as delivered only when
  the host proves it was processed (that turn's model reply); an unconfirmed
  note is requeued, never silently dropped. A note steered into a running turn
  counts as delivered at the hand-off. Repetition is suppressed by finding
  identity plus similarity, with hash-based mutes.

## Install

The package is a Cordis plugin (`dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`) and is
published on npm with a provenance attestation, so it installs like any other
profile bundle:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @wweir/dsh-advisor
```

A development checkout can be linked instead (`dsh plugin … add /path/to/checkout`);
its deploy path is described in `docs/OPERATIONS.md`.

Then give it a model route. It is **disabled until a model is configured**, and
it never falls back to the Executor's model:

```yaml
- id: advisor
  name: '@wweir/dsh-advisor'
  config:
    enabled: true
    model:
      provider: opencode-go
      model: glm-5.3-flash
      reasoningEffort: low
    instructions: ''            # extra review instructions, appended to the prompt
    review:
      everySteps: 8             # minimum completed steps between two reviews (0 = off)
      timeoutMs: 180000         # wall-clock bound for one review
      maxContextTokens: 64000   # upper bound on the review prompt (the model's window can lower it)
      maxAdviceChars: 2000      # one advice body
      maxPending: 32            # queued, not-yet-delivered notes
    delivery:
      activeIdleSeverities: [concern, blocker]   # severities allowed to wake an idle Executor
    security:
      additionalProtectedPaths: []      # extra paths the reviewer may never read
```

A patch entry is **replaced, not merged**, per row id: an overlay that sets
only the extra instructions drops the model route, so the row loads **disabled**;
it fails loudly, with a validation error, only when the overlay also asks for
`enabled: true`.

## Behaviour worth knowing

- **Trigger** — one cadence: a completed *step*, i.e. one model call plus the
  tools it ran. Steps are the host's progress unit, so the same counter covers
  work inside a long turn (which crosses no reply boundary for dozens of steps)
  and work spread across many short turns; there is no second, reply-based
  interval that could disagree with it. A review starts once `everySteps` steps
  (default 8) have accrued since the previous one finished. The cursor moves
  when a review *finishes*, so a slow review cannot chain into the next one; the
  counter and cursor are absolute and persisted, so a reload continues the
  cadence instead of forgiving the steps that accrued since the last review. A
  fresh session is first reviewed after a full cadence, not immediately. The
  turn's final answer starts no review of its own: the steps that produced it
  already had their chance, so the tail of a session that stops mid-cadence is
  reviewed by the next steps that accrue. Sub-agent sessions (including the
  review children) are never reviewed. Turns this plugin opened itself are never
  reviewed either.
- **Review child limits** — one review is one bounded attempt. It may run at
  most five reads or searches; a further call is refused with the reason to
  conclude from the evidence it already has. At 70 % of `timeoutMs` it is
  steered to conclude, and silence stays a valid conclusion; at the deadline the
  child is cancelled and the attempt is recorded as a failure. A failed review
  does not advance the reviewed boundary, so its material is re-read by the next
  attempt, while the cadence cursor still moves, so a broken route is not
  retried once per step.
- **Delivery** — while the Executor is running the note is handed into the
  next step boundary; while it is idle the note may open

plugins.description: A sidebar prompt template library for DeepSeek Harness: browse, manage, and insert reusable prompts into the composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# Prompt Library for DeepSeek Harness

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that keeps reusable prompt templates one click away. It adds a searchable template library to the sidebar and a compact picker to the message composer. Choosing a template inserts it at the caret, or starts a new conversation with the template already in the draft when no conversation is open.

Repository: <https://github.com/qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt>

## Features

- **Sidebar library** — a bookmark entry in the left sidebar opens a full library panel.
- **Composer picker** — a small bookmark button in the composer tool row opens a compact, searchable picker without leaving the conversation.
- **Insert at the caret** — templates are inserted into the current draft; a selection is replaced. The edit is undoable through the composer's normal undo history.
- **No-conversation fallback** — with no conversation open, choosing a template starts a new conversation and puts the template in the draft.
- **Template management** — create, edit, delete, duplicate, copy, search, and filter templates by category.
- **Categories** — create a category before it has templates. The empty category offers **New template in this category**. A name matching a built-in category label belongs to that built-in category instead of creating a duplicate.
- **Eight built-in templates** — code review, refactoring, tests, debugging, explanation, summarization, translation, and structured research. They follow the UI language and are read-only; **Save as mine** creates an editable copy.
- **English and Simplified Chinese UI** — the interface follows the DSH language setting.
- **No configuration required** — no API key, token, password, account, or external service.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** or newer, with the Web or Desktop UI.
- A DSH profile in which bundles can be installed (the default Desktop profile is fine).
- Network access to GitHub when installing from this repository.

The plugin is a **bundle**, not a standalone web page. Install it through DSH's plugin manager; do not try to open `client.js` directly.

The repository root is the installable package root. It contains `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `index.js`, and `client.js`; there is no monorepo subdirectory and no build step.

## Install from GitHub

### Desktop / Web (recommended)

1. In DSH, open **Plugins**.
2. Choose **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin**.
3. Paste the repository address:

   ```text
   https://github.com/qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt
   ```

4. Review the trust notice and confirm the installation. DSH reads `package.json` and installs the bundle.
5. If the `prompt-library` row remains off, enable it in **Plugins**.
6. If the sidebar bookmark does not appear, refresh the Web GUI once.

### CLI

`dsh plugin --profile <name> add ...` forwards the install to pnpm in that profile. Use the profile you actually run (`web`, `desktop`, or a custom profile):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt
```

The equivalent GitHub URL form is accepted by pnpm-based installs:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt
```

A git install fetches sources, not a prebuilt artifact. This package is plain JavaScript with no `prepare`/`build` script, so pnpm does not need to run an install-time build and users are not asked to allow one.

Do not edit the profile's `package.json` or `cordis.patch.yml` by hand; the plugin manager owns those files.

### Local checkout (development)

Install the absolute path to this repository as a linked bundle:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile dev add /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-prompt
```

The plugin manager links the checkout into the profile, so edits to `client.js` are picked up after a page refresh. Replace `dev` with a disposable profile name; do not mix development links into a profile you rely on.

### Update and uninstall

DSH upgrades non-official plugins by uninstalling and reinstalling them. Uninstall the bundle in **Plugins**, then install the new repository version. With the CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-prompt
dsh plugin --profile web add github:qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt
```

Removing the bundle removes the sidebar entry and composer picker. Templates already saved in the browser are not deleted by uninstalling; clear the keys below if you want to remove them.

## Configuration

The plugin has **no Config schema** and no required settings. There is no API key, token, password, endpoint, or model selection to configure.

| Setting | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Templates | Managed in the library panel or the template editor. |
| Categories | Created with **New category** or by typing a new category in the template editor. |
| Language | Follows the DSH language setting (`English` or `简体中文`). |
| Built-in templates | Fixed in the plugin; **Save as mine** creates an editable copy. |

### Browser storage

Templates and categories are stored in the Harness Web origin's `localStorage`:

- `dsh.prompt-library.templates.v1` — user templates.
- `dsh.prompt-library.categories.v1` — categories that exist independently of templates. When this key is missing, categories already used by saved templates are migrated into it.

`localStorage` is scoped to the Web origin. A different origin, browser profile, or cleared browser storage has separate data. The plugin does not write templates to the session log, does not send them to a server, and does not read credentials. When you send a message, its text reaches your configured model through DSH as usual.

## Usage

### Sidebar library

1. Click the bookmark entry in the left sidebar.
2. Search by title, text, or category, or choose a category chip.
3. Choose **Insert** to put the template into the current draft, **Copy** to copy it, or **Save as mine** to duplicate a built-in template.
4. Use **New category** to create a category before it has templates.
5. Use the back arrow in the panel header to return to the conversation.

### Composer picker

1. Click the bookmark button in the composer's left tool row.
2. In a new, empty conversation the picker opens as a centered dialog, so the search field is always visible; in an active conversation it opens above the composer.
3. Search for a template. Use the arrow keys to move and Enter to insert, or click a row.
4. The template is inserted at the caret (or replaces the current selection).

### Example

Create a reusable review prompt:

1. Open the sidebar library.
2. Choose **New template**.
3. Set the title to `Review a pull request`, the category to `Engineering`, and the body to:

   ```text
   Review this change for correctness, edge cases, performance, security,
   and maintainability. List issues by severity, then give concrete fixes.

   ```

4. Save. The template appears under **My templates**.
5. In any conversation, click the composer bookmark, choose the template, and it is inserted at the caret.

### Empty categories

A newly created category is selected immediately. Until it has templates, the panel shows **No templates in this category yet** and **New template in this category**. That button opens the editor with the category prefilled.

Categories can be created and selected, but renaming or deleting a category is not yet supported.

## Compatibility

- Built and verified with **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2**.
- The package declares `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0"`. Installation and profile startup refuse a bundle outside that range.
- The client half uses the public slot entries `sidebar.panellist`, `main`, `conversation.input.left`, and `conversation.input.overlay`, plus the composer's `InputActions.captureInsertion()` / `insertText()`.
- If a future DSH release changes those slots, the plugin may need an update. Please include the DSH version in bug reports.

## Privacy and security

- No analytics, telemetry, or network calls of its own.
- No credential, API key, token, cookie, or account access.
- No host filesystem access; the host half is an empty `apply()` row.

plugins.description: 手机端交互与可读性适配：抽屉式侧栏（滑动开合 + 可调宽度）、滑动手势、触控命中区、软键盘避让、正文字号下限。Mobile interaction & readability layer for DSH Web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mobile-adapt

在手机上用 DSH Web，手感更顺一点。

原版界面是按电脑设计的：侧栏挤在一列里、按钮太小不好点、键盘弹出来挡住输入框、字偏小。这个插件把这些都调成适合手指用的样子。

## 功能

**侧栏变成抽屉**

- 右滑打开，左滑收起，手指跟着走；
- 宽度可以调：点一下按钮换一档（60% / 75% / 90% / 满屏），按住左右拖能连续调；
- 调过的宽度会记住，下次打开还是那样。

**手势**

- 右滑：打开侧栏；
- 左滑（侧栏开着时）：收起侧栏；
- 返回键：先关弹窗，再关侧栏，不会一不小心退出 App。

**会话列表好点也好认**

- 标题放大到 16px，长标题**折成两行**显示，不再一刀切成「手机端 dsh 适配手机交…」；
- 每行的时间（6 分钟 / 1 天）保留并放大，随时知道上次是什么时候聊的；
- 行末只留一个 `⋯` 按钮，归档、置顶、重命名都在它弹出的菜单里，不再占三格；
- 按钮放大到 40×40，行高跟着变高，拇指点得准；
- **拖动排序保留原样**：按住标题拖就能调整顺序，插件不拦这个手势。

**点得准**

- 按钮和菜单项放大到手指好按的大小，按下去有反馈；
- 去掉点完要等一下才能点的老毛病。

**键盘不挡输入框**

- 弹出键盘时界面自动往上让，输入框始终看得见。

**字更清楚**

- 正文最小 15px，输入框固定 16px；
- 你要是自己调过字号，插件不会覆盖，只是保证不会小于 15px。

**滚动不跑偏**

- 代码块、表格可以单独左右滑，不会把整个页面拖歪。

## 安装

```sh
bash install.sh              # 安装
bash install.sh --uninstall  # 卸载
```

装完刷新页面就生效，不用重启。

## 想自己调

打开 `lib/client.js`，改这几个：

| 改什么 | 找这个 |
| --- | --- |
| 多大的屏幕才算手机 | `PHONE_QUERY` |
| 正文最小字号 | `MIN_CONTENT_PX` |
| 宽度有哪几档 | `WIDTH_STEPS` |
| 默认宽度 | `DEFAULT_RATIO` |

改完重新跑 `bash install.sh`，刷新页面。

## 兼容

- 不往顶栏加按钮，也不强行改别的插件的控件大小，和大多数插件能一起用；
- 支持 **DSH 0.2 及以后所有版本**（没有写死版本上限，市场里升级到高版本 DSH 也不会被判定不兼容）；
- 只在窄屏（宽度 ≤767px）生效，电脑上不会改变任何东西。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: DSH plugin: delete archived sessions with reference-aware attachment garbage collection, as one reversible transaction.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archived-chat-cleanup（已归档会话清理）

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-archived-chat-cleanup.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-archived-chat-cleanup)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

> A DSH plugin that deletes **archived** sessions together with their exclusively-referenced
> attachment objects and derived request-image caches — one reference-aware, journalled,
> reversible transaction. Install by package name: `dsh-archived-chat-cleanup`.

## 安装

**通过 DSH 输入包名安装（推荐）**：在 DSH 插件管理器里输入 `dsh-archived-chat-cleanup`，
或使用 CLI：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-archived-chat-cleanup
```

安装/升级后需要重启宿主（模块缓存按包说明符生效）。

从源码安装（本地开发）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add <插件目录的绝对路径>
```

## English overview

DSH stores attachments content-addressed: one object can be referenced by many sessions, so
deleting a session must not blindly delete its attachments. This plugin deletes only archived
sessions, cascades into their subagent child sessions, scans every surviving session for
`sha256:` references, removes only unreferenced attachment objects, clears the
`request-images` derived caches, and updates the live indexes through the running services.
Every file move is journalled and reversible, including crash recovery on the next boot.

It ships a Host half (`delete_archived_session` tool + `archivedCleanup` Remote namespace) and
a browser half (two rows in the archived session's “…” menu). See the Chinese sections below
for the full behaviour, transaction protocol and test coverage.

删除**已归档**会话，并按引用关系回收附件实体；整个过程是一个可回滚的事务。
Host 半 + 浏览器半在同一个包里，安装后提供三个入口：会话「...」菜单、模型工具、Remote API。

## 它解决什么

DSH 的附件是**内容寻址**的：同一张图被多个会话引用时磁盘上只有一份。
所以"删除会话"不能简单地把附件一起删掉，必须先判断还有没有别的会话在引用。
DSH 自身没有删除会话的 API（`sessionPersistence` / `attachments` 都没有 delete），
这些数据只能由插件自己按事务方式落盘删除。

## 行为

一次删除调用按顺序完成：

1. **归档校验**：目标必须在 `workspaceRegistry.archivedSessionIds`（界面上的"已归档"）里。
   非归档会话直接拒绝（`session-not-archived`）。
2. **运行中会话**：`one` 模式整体拒绝（`target-live`）；`all` 模式**跳过**该会话及其全部子会话并在结果里报告（`skippedLive`），绝不删正在写的日志。
3. **级联**：递归带上目标会话的子代理子会话（它们是归档会话的内部会话，保留会让附件被"永久引用"）。
4. **取目标会话的附件引用**：完整读取会话日志，扫描其中出现的所有 `sha256:<64hex>`。
5. **取存活会话的引用**：扫描除目标外的**所有**现存会话（磁盘 + 内存 live，不区分是否归档）。
6. **判定**：
   - 未被任何存活会话引用 → 删除附件实体（镜像对象 `attachments/v1/objects/`、
     文件对象 `file-objects/`、以及别名目录 `files/`）；
   - 仍被其他会话引用 → **不删**，只随目标会话一起删除那条引用（引用存在会话日志里）；
   - 任何存活会话日志读不出来 → 整个操作中止（fail-closed，宁可不删）。
7. **删除派生缓存**：`<cacheRoot>/request-images` 与旧版遗留的 `attachments/v1/request-images`
   整体清掉（按"源对象+请求尺寸"派生，无法精确归属到某个会话，且下次看图会自动重建）。
8. **删除会话正文与索引引用**：会话目录、投影缓存记录（`session_projcache` 域）、
   message_feedback 记录、workspace 归属与归档集合。
   索引一律走**活着的服务/域**，不直接改文件——`workspaceRegistry` 会在内存里缓存状态，
   直接改文件会被它写回（这正是前两次手工清理踩过的坑）。

### 事务与回滚

- **阶段一**：把每个待删路径 `rename` 进隔离区（同卷、原子），每步写一次 journal；
- **阶段二**：改索引（先快照原值）；
- **阶段三**：两者都成功后彻底清空隔离区。
- 任意一步失败：先回滚索引，再逆序把文件搬回原位，journal 记为 `rolled-back`（隔离区清掉，journal 留作审计）。
- 进程崩溃：下次启动扫描 journal，自动恢复未完成的事务；`rollback-incomplete` 表示恢复不完全，需人工看 journal。
- 所有待删路径必须**严格位于**会话根/附件根/缓存根之内，否则 `unsafe-path` 中止。

## 用法

| 入口 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 会话「...」菜单 | 仅在该会话已归档时显示"删除已归档会话…"（order 500）与"清理全部已归档会话…"（order 501），**点两次**才执行 |
| 模型工具 `delete_archived_session` | `{ mode: "one"\|"all", session_id?, dry_run?, confirm }`；`dry_run:true` 只报告计划；真正删除需 `confirm:true` |
| Remote 命名空间 `archivedCleanup` | 端点 `archivedCleanup/status`、`/preview`、`/deleteArchived`，参数按名字传 `{ mode, sessionId, confirm }` |

## 路径与数据

- 会话根：`ctx.sessionPersistence.root`（回退：Loader 配置 / `DSH_HOME/sessions`）
- 附件根：`ctx.attachments.root`（回退 `DSH_HOME/attachments/v1`）
- 派生缓存：`ctx.attachments.cacheRoot`（回退 `DSH_HOME/cache/attachments`）
- 插件数据：`DSH_HOME/plugin-data/archived-cleanup/`（`transactions/` journal，`reports/` 执行报告）

plugins.description: Draft, lay out, and deliver editable Word documents with a reopened-file check.
plugins.readme_text:
# WordCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![WordCraft Use — editable business documents](assets/official-logo.png)

> Draft, lay out, and deliver editable Word documents from an agent session, with real section structures, native tables, and a reopened-file check before handoff.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](#positioning)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-16-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP servers](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20servers-1-6E56CF)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [MCP tools](#mcp-tools) · [Limits](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`wordcraft` turns source material into an editable document rather than a text dump: it collects the real facts, fills a section and field structure, lays the result out with native headings, tables, page numbers, and headers, then reopens the file and checks what the reader will actually see. It wraps the native WordCraft engine in sixteen skills and one embedded editor.

This is an installable development candidate. Production promotion is blocked, embedded host synchronization is not accepted, and short one-page samples do not prove that arbitrary long documents paginate correctly.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Plugin ID | `wordcraft` |
| Display name | WordCraft Use |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.5` |
| Stage | Installable development candidate, production promotion blocked |
| Native engine | WordCraft 0.7.0 via `wordcraft-cli` |
| Marketplace | `wordcraft-marketplace` |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Codex is the host with recorded evidence. Other hosts are not accepted.
- Node.js 24 or newer is required by the embedded editor. The distributed package already contains the editor build; no Rust toolchain and no `npm install` are needed at runtime.
- Native file workflows use `wordcraft-cli`, which this plugin does not install. Query the installed version and command schema before running a recipe.
- The first Git-based launch needs network access or an existing verified editor cache. Complete release ZIPs can start offline from bundled assets.
- Windows Git installs need long-path support: `git config --global core.longpaths true`.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add wordcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

The repository also ships its own marketplace metadata (`wordcraft-marketplace`) pinned to `v0.1.0-dev.20261018.5`. Restart the host, open a new task, and state the document type and the real source material.

## Quick start

1. Say what to produce and from what: “Write this week's report from these work notes; mark anything missing as pending confirmation.”
2. Let the agent choose the document skill and fill real fields. Templates describe sections, required fields, and native layout operations; they are not empty outlines with a new title.
3. Ask for a new editable DOCX plus a review PDF. Templates are designed for new documents, not for overwriting an existing file.
4. Reopen the DOCX, check heading levels, cell-by-cell table content, and column counts, then compare against the PDF page.

```text
Meeting minutes: turn these notes into minutes with decisions and action items.
Weekly report: summarize progress, blockers, and next week's plan.
Proposal: produce a project proposal with phases, deliverables, and owners.
Quotation: build a line-item table with quantities and decimal prices; do not infer tax.
```

Direct CLI form for file tasks, one method per argv argument; verify text afterwards with `wordcraft-cli text out.docx`:

```bash
wordcraft-cli run --cmd 'text.insert={"text":"Body text"}' --save out.docx
```

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Meeting minutes | `wordcraft-meeting-minutes` | Decisions, owners, and action items in an editable table |
| Weekly report | `wordcraft-weekly-report` | Completed, in-progress, blocked, and next-step sections kept separate |
| Project proposal | `wordcraft-business-proposal` | Goals, phases, deliverables, and planned dates |
| Requirements document | `wordcraft-requirements-document` | Numbered requirements with observable acceptance conditions |
| Acceptance report | `wordcraft-acceptance-report` | Expected versus actual results, with failed items preserved |
| Business letter | `wordcraft-business-letter` | Recipient, subject, confirmed facts, and requested reply |
| Commercial quotation | `wordcraft-quotation` | Native line-item table, per-line amounts, and a checked total |
| Research and resume layout | `wordcraft-research-report`, `wordcraft-resume-layout` | Structured sections, figures, references, and a compact layout |
| Long-form structure | `wordcraft-toc-handbook`, `wordcraft-illustrated-guide`, `wordcraft-landscape-appendix` | Updatable table of contents, captioned figures, and portrait body with landscape appendix |
| Revision and playbooks | `wordcraft-document-comparison`, `wordcraft-document-style`, `wordcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Text and structure diff, unified styles, eight checked recipes |

## Skills

### Document templates

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-meeting-minutes` | Build minutes from discussion, decisions, and action items |
| `wordcraft-weekly-report` | Build a weekly report from work records, progress, and next-week plans |
| `wordcraft-business-proposal` | Build a proposal with goals, approach, plan, and delivery |
| `wordcraft-requirements-document` | Turn interviews or drafts into numbered, testable requirements |
| `wordcraft-acceptance-report` | Record acceptance criteria, measured results, and open issues |
| `wordcraft-business-letter` | Draft a business letter from recipient, subject, and confirmed facts |

### Commercial and layout

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-quotation` | Compile explicit line items into a native table and verify decimal totals |
| `wordcraft-research-report` | Lay out abstract, sections, figures, tables, and references |
| `wordcraft-resume-layout` | Lay out experience and outcomes in a compact resume |
| `wordcraft-document-style` | Unify headings, paragraphs, lists, and tables across a document |

### Long-form and comparison

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-toc-handbook` | Produce a handbook with an updatable table of contents |
| `wordcraft-illustrated-guide` | Produce a guide with images and captions |
| `wordcraft-landscape-appendix` | Combine a portrait body with a landscape matrix appendix |
| `wordcraft-document-comparison` | Compare two versions for textual and structural differences |

### Session and playbooks

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-editor` | Open the real editor in an MCP Apps host or host browser and share one workspace session |
| `wordcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Eight recipes for project briefs, SOPs, release notes, decision tables, letters, training decks, and two-column briefs |

## MCP tools

`.codex-plugin/mcp.json` starts one stdio server, `wordcraft-editor`, from `ui/bootstrap.mjs`. The adapter adds three stable tools and passes through the pinned engine's document tool catalog.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `open_editor` | Open the editor for an absolute `workspace`; the first call binds the workspace |
| `open_browser_editor` | Return an `editorUrl` for the same session when the host has a built-in browser |
| `editor_status` | Report whether the editor actually attached and is ready

# dsh-desktop-notify

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Desktop notifications for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
A Windows toast appears when a Session needs you — and clicking it brings that
Session back to the front.

Two triggers:

| Trigger | When it fires |
| --- | --- |
| **Needs attention** | The Agent is blocked waiting for your approval or your answer. |
| **Run finished** | A Session that was running has stopped, and the run lasted at least `minRunMs`. |

## Install

Requires the **Desktop** application (the Windows toast path depends on Electron
running the renderer; a browser tab has no AppUserModelID to notify under).

### From the DSH plugin page (no terminal)

Open **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**, and paste one of these into
**Package name or address**:

| What you paste | When to use it |
| --- | --- |
| `github:guanhaisen/dsh-desktop-notify` | Straight from this repository. Nothing published to npm. |
| `https://github.com/guanhaisen/dsh-desktop-notify` | Same thing, written as a URL. |
| `D:\path\to\dsh-desktop-notify` | A local checkout. **Must be an absolute path.** |

Then press **Install**. The plugin manager runs `pnpm add` in your profile, adds
the bundle to the profile's list, and the notification half activates without a
restart in most cases — reload the page (`Ctrl+R`) if the first toast does not
arrive.

> Installing from git resolves the repository's **default branch**. If you fork
> this and your default branch differs, paste the full spec with a ref instead:
> `github:you/dsh-desktop-notify#main`.

> The plugin page states that installed plugins **do not auto-update**: to
> upgrade, uninstall and install again. A `github:` install follows the default
> branch, so reinstalling picks up new commits.

### From the command line

```bash
# In your DSH desktop profile directory:
#   Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm add github:guanhaisen/dsh-desktop-notify
```

Or link a working copy, so edits apply on save:

```bash
pnpm add link:/path/to/dsh-desktop-notify
```

Either way, the package must then appear in that directory's `package.json`
bundle list — the plugin page does this for you; a manual install does not:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...existing bundles...", "dsh-desktop-notify"]
    }
  }
}
```

> Keep this package free of runtime `dependencies`. pnpm does not install a
> linked package's own dependencies, and a resolution failure during Cordis tree
> initialisation stops DSH from starting.

### You will not see a toast when…

This is the part that looks like a bug and is not:

| Situation | Why it is silent |
| --- | --- |
| You are looking at that Session | The prompt is already on screen. |
| The run was shorter than `minRunMs` (20 s) | A quick reply is not news. |
| The Session was already running when the window opened | The first snapshot is a baseline, so opening DSH does not fire a burst. |
| Windows **Do Not Disturb** is on | The OS suppresses the banner. The notification still reaches the notification centre. |

If none of those apply and nothing appears, read the decision log — see
[Verifying it actually works](#verifying-it-actually-works). It records every
suppression *with its reason*, so "why did I not get a toast?" is answerable.

## Why this is a plugin and not a shell patch

The obvious implementation — add a `Notification` call to the Electron main
process — cannot work here, and understanding why explains the whole design.

The Desktop Host is **not** the Electron main process. `lib/main.js` spawns it as
a *separate Node child process*:

```js
spawn(this.node, ['--expose-internals', entry, ...], { stdio: ['ignore','pipe','pipe','ipc'] })
```

That child is the Electron executable re-entered in Node mode, so
`require('electron')` inside a Host plugin yields no `Notification`, and the
process holds no AppUserModelID. Meanwhile the shell's own notification code
(`lib/main.js`) only ever fires for one thing: a mandatory update.

The renderer, however, has everything needed:

- `dsh-app:` is registered as a privileged scheme with `standard: true` and
  `secure: true`, making the window a **secure context**, which the Web
  Notification API requires.
- The application session installs a permission handler that returns `true` for
  every non-media permission.

So a plain Web `Notification` in the window becomes a real Windows toast under
the application's own identity (`electron.app.DeepSeek Harness`). No shell
patch, no helper process, and it survives application updates.

## Where the state comes from

Nothing is polled and no second source of truth is created.
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session` already folds exactly these facts and
publishes them as `ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus`:

```
Map<sessionId, { running, pendingInteraction, completionUnread }>
```

It is fed by the `api-session/status` Remote event. This plugin only reads it.

`pendingInteraction` is the interaction object itself, whose `kind` is one of:

| `kind` | Raised by | Copy shown |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `approval` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-approval` | Tool named in the request is asking for privileged execution |
| `question` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions` | The Agent asked a question |
| `plan-review` | same, when the questions are a plan | A plan is waiting for review |

Its `key` is the identity used to de-duplicate, so a status re-emission for the
same wait never produces a second toast.

## Layout

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half. Owns the Loader row the browser half binds to. Registers nothing — no tool, no service, no route. |
| `client.js` | Browser half. Watches Session status, decides when to notify, renders the toast, wires click-through, and publishes the `DesktopNotify` Inspect provider. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The one Host row the bundle inserts. |
| `test/watcher.test.mjs` | Behavioural test of the decision logic, runnable with plain `node`. |

## Configuration

Set on the plugin's row in the profile patch, or via the Plugins page:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notifyOnAttention` | `true` | Notify when a Session is blocked on you. |
| `notifyOnComplete` | `true` | Notify when a run finishes. |
| `minRunMs` | `20000` | Ignore runs shorter than this. Quick replies are not news. |
| `sound` | `true` | Play the system notification sound. |

### De-duplication

A repeated interaction never re-notifies: identity is the interaction's own
`key`, so a status re-emission for the same pending approval stays silent. The
first snapshot after the window opens is treated as a baseline rather than as
news, which is what stops a launch from firing a burst of toasts for Sessions
that were already running.

## Verifying it actually works

Delivery is asynchronous and visual, and neither half can observe the toast the
operating system renders. So the browser half publishes a Cordis Inspect
provider, `DesktopNotify`, which can be queried from outside the page:

| Method | Answers |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | Is the half mounted? What is `Notification.permission`? Is this a secure context? Which Sessions are tracked, and since when? |
| `testToast` | Fire one real toast now, and report what was constructed. |
| `decisions` | The in-memory decision log — every notification sent *and* every one deliberately suppressed, with the reason. |

`decisions` is the one that answers "why did I not get a toast?": a suppressed
entry carries `suppressed: 'watched'` (you were looking at that Session) or
`suppressed: 'too-short'` (the run ended before `minRunMs`).

The log is **in memory only**, bounded to the last 100 entries. It is
deliberately not written to disk: a file that can silently fail to appear is
worse than no file at all.

### Confirming against the OS

`testToast` reporting `delivered: true` only means a `Notification` was
constructed. To confirm it reached the operating system, compare Windows' own
record for this app's AUMID before and after:

```powershell
$k = 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Notifications\Settings\electron.app.DeepSeek Harness'
[DateTime]::FromFi

plugins.readme_text:
# AI 课程（dsh-ai-courses）

把「一个学习诉求 + 手头资料」变成一门**结构化、可讲授、可反复翻阅、纯本地**的 AI 课程。

在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 `/ai-course` 建课，在侧边栏「AI 课程」里管课、按章节/知识点生成内容，在学习页里阅读图文、幻灯片与图表。课程数据全部落在本地文件里，可以直接打开、diff、备份或整目录拷贝。

> 适用：DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`，Web UI（含桌面端的 Web 界面）。  
> 运行形态：host + client 双半插件；包本身零运行时依赖。

---

## 目录

- [功能一览](#功能一览)
- [安装](#安装)
- [快速开始](#快速开始)
- [参考资料与附件](#参考资料与附件)
- [配置](#配置)
- [数据与备份](#数据与备份)
- [升级、停用与卸载](#升级停用与卸载)
- [已知限制](#已知限制)
- [故障排查](#故障排查)
- [从源码开发](#从源码开发)
- [License](#license)

---

## 功能一览

- **`/ai-course` 建课**：一句学习诉求（可带附件/资料路径）→ 课程、章节、知识点大纲。
  命令卡片显示推导阶段与用时；成功后同一条回复末尾出现可编辑的大纲卡片。
- **三种粒度生成内容**：整门课 / 某一章 / 单个知识点。后台任务，刷新页面不丢；
  宿主重启后残留任务标记为 `interrupted`，不会假装还在跑。
- **内容类型**：`图文`（Markdown）、`幻灯片`（Slidev 方言）。`音频` / `视频` / `代码` / `测验`
  目前按 Markdown 降级生成，界面标注「格式待定」。
- **学习页**：Markdown 子集、Slidev 播放器、Mermaid 图表、代码高亮、本地媒体。
  打开**有内容**的知识点 → `进行中`，离开 → `已掌握`；章节/课程进度自动聚合。
- **课程库**：按标签/分类过滤、按名称搜索、打开大纲、进入学习、删除课程（整个课程目录）。
- **课程库设置**：右上角配置按钮可直接修改 `courseRoot`，保存后立即切换目录，无需重启。
- **纯本地数据**：`<courseRoot>/<courseId>/` 下的 JSON + Markdown；无外部存储 backend。
- **引用资料**：建课诉求/附件里点名的文本文件会随课程保存，生成内容时作为「参考资料」注入 prompt。
- **不占用旧 `course` 格位**：面板与 slot id 是 `ai-courses`，可与在装的 `dsh-course-plugin` 共存。

### Agent 工具

模型在会话里可以直接调用三个工具；UI 与工具走同一张 RPC 方法表，语义一致：

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `course_read` | 读取课程、大纲与学习进度；生成内容前先读上下文 |
| `course_generate` | 为整门课 / 某一章 / 某些知识点发起后台生成 |
| `course_content_asset_put` | 写回某个知识点的内容资产（正文一律 Markdown） |

---

## 安装

### 前置条件

- 已安装并启动 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2 或更新版本**。
- 使用 **Web UI**：`dsh web`，或桌面端内置的 Web 界面。
  TUI / headless 没有课程面板（client half 的 `platform` 是 `web`）。
- DSH 进程对课程库目录有读写权限；默认是 `~/.dsh/ai-courses`。
- 内容生成需要可用的模型与会话（生成动作由某个会话承载模型调用）。
- 从源码构建时另需 Node.js 20+。

### 方式一：npm / CLI

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ai-courses
```

桌面端把 `web` 换成 `desktop`：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ai-courses
```

这条命令会同时写入 profile 的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles`，不需要手工编辑 profile。

> **已知版本问题**：
> ① 0.1.2 及更早在 `dsh web` 下，客户端在 sidebar 槽声明之前就注册 `sidebar.panellist`，
> 会报 `dsh-ai-courses: failed` —— **0.1.3 已修复**；
> ② 0.1.3 及更早在中文 DSH 下仍可能显示英文 —— apply 时把 `<html lang>` 的初始 `en` 锁死，
> **0.1.4 起修复**（动态读取语言）。
> 建议安装 **0.1.4 或更新版本**。

> 如果 registry 上还搜不到 `dsh-ai-courses`（首次发布尚未完成），用方式三或方式四。

### 方式二：插件市场（推荐）

先确认已安装插件市场：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket
```

重启 `dsh web`，打开 **设置 → 插件市场**，搜索「AI 课程」并安装。

> 桌面端通常已内置插件市场；没有的话把 `web` 换成 `desktop` 装一次。
> 如果市场里还搜不到，说明尚未收录；用下面的 npm 或本地方式。

### 方式三：从源码构建安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aix-plugin/ai-courses.git
cd ai-courses

# Mermaid 是浏览器按需加载的 vendor 文件；仓库已带，缺失时下载
node scripts/vendor-mermaid.mjs

# src/ → package/
node scripts/build.mjs

# 安装的是构建产物 package/，不是仓库根目录
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/package"
```

> ⚠️ 仓库根目录没有 `package.json`，`dsh plugin add` 必须指向 `package/`。

### 方式四：本地 tarball（内网/离线分发）

```bash
cd ai-courses/package
npm pack
# 产出 dsh-ai-courses-<version>.tgz
# 注意用绝对路径：dsh plugin 在 profile 目录里执行 pnpm，相对路径会解析错
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/dsh-ai-courses-<version>.tgz"
```

### 安装后确认

1. **完全退出并重新打开 DSH**。新装 bundle 有时能热加载，但**替换/升级必须重启**才能加载新的 JS 模块。
2. 打开 **设置 → 插件**，确认 `dsh-ai-courses` 存在且已启用。
3. 侧边栏出现「AI 课程」面板。
4. 在会话里输入 `/`，能看到 `/ai-course`。

如果只有面板没有命令，或只有命令没有面板，通常是 host/client 有一半没加载：重启并查看宿主日志。

---

## 快速开始

### 1. 建课

在任意会话里发送：

```
/ai-course 用 3 章讲清 React Server Components，我熟悉 Vue 不熟 React
```

也可以带上资料：

```
/ai-course 根据 ./docs/rsc-spec.md 和附件，用 3 章讲清 React Server Components
```

建课时会发生：

- 命令卡片显示「已收到诉求，正在交给模型 / 已拿到课程结构，正在校验 / 正在写入课程库」等阶段与用时。
- 成功后回复末尾出现**课程大纲卡片**：章节、知识点、类型、时长（内容生成后回填）、生成状态、学习进度。
- 可以直接在卡片里改名、增删章节与知识点，也可以点「打开完整大纲」。
- 如果已存在同名课程，会先展示已有大纲并询问是否新建，避免误建重复课程。

### 2. 管理课程

打开侧边栏「AI 课程」：

- 课程库：按标签/分类过滤，按名称搜索。
- 课程库右上角的配置图标：修改 `courseRoot`，保存后立即切换（见[配置](#配置)）。
- 课程卡片：名称、描述、标签、学习进度、大纲入口、学习入口、删除。
- 大纲页：修正章节/知识点，发起内容生成。

### 3. 生成内容

在大纲页、学习页或生成弹窗里选择范围：

- 生成整门课内容
- 生成本章全部内容
- 生成这个知识点

说明：

- 生成在后台进行，界面按约 1.5s 轮询进度；刷新页面不丢任务。
- 已有内容时会询问「保留并追加」还是「覆盖」。
- 生成需要由一个会话承载模型调用；如果提示「先打开任意会话」，先在左侧新建/打开一个会话。
- 宿主重启后，未完成的任务会标记为 `interrupted`，可以重新发起。
- 输入框上方的常驻状态条会显示「正在为哪门课写哪个知识点 / 已完成几个」，切换面板也能看到。

### 4. 学习

点击课程卡片上的「学习」，或在大纲里点某个已生成内容的知识点：

- `图文`：本地 Markdown 正文；支持 Mermaid 图表、代码高亮、示意图。
- `幻灯片`：Slidev 方言 Markdown，按页播放，支持讲稿。
- `音频` / `视频` / `代码` / `测验`：当前按 Markdown 降级展示，标注「格式待定」。
- 打开**有内容**的知识点 → `进行中`；离开/切换 → `已掌握`。没有额外的「标记已掌握」按钮。

### 5. 删除课程

课程卡片底部 → 删除 → 二次确认。

删除会连同该课程的章节、知识点、内容资产、生成任务、学习进度**一起删掉**（删除整个课程目录），且不可撤销。如果只是暂时不用这个插件，先在设置里停用它，不要删课程数据。

---

## 参考资料与附件

建课时可以通过两种方式提供资料：

1. **附件**：输入框的附件按钮，或 `@` 选择文件。
2. **诉求里的路径**：例如 `./docs/spec.md`、`@/tmp/notes.md`、`~/notes/spec.yaml`。

边界：

- 只读取**文本类**文件（md / txt / json / yaml / ts / py / csv 等）。
- 图片、二进制、URL 不会被抓取；不联网抓网页。
- 最多 **6 个**引用；单文件 **6000 字符**、单次合计 **24000 字符**，超出会截断并在 prompt 里标注「以上为节选」。
- 文件不存在 / 不是文本 / 无权限时**静默跳过**，不会阻断建课或生成。
- 诉求原文与附件副本会存进课程目录的 `sources/`，之后生成知识点时继续作为参考资料。

---

## 配置

### `courseRoot`

默认课程库：

```
~/.dsh/ai-courses
```

### 从界面修改（推荐）

课程库右上角 → **配置图标** → 修改「课程库目录（courseRoot）」→ **保存并切换**。

- 保存后**立即生效**，不需要重启 DSH；课程库会刷新到新目录。
- 旧目录里的课程**不会被移动或删除**；切回旧路径仍然能看到。
- 有生成任务或课程推导在跑时不允许切换，等任务结束再试。
- 设置保存在当前 profile 目录的 `ai-courses.settings.json`，**优先于** profile patch 里的 `courseRoot`。
- 目录必须是绝对路径；`~` 会展开；目标目录必须可写（host 会自动创建并做一次写探测）。
- 弹窗里会显示「当前生效」目录、来源（默认值 / profile 配置 / 界面设置）和设置文件位置。

### 从 profile patch 修改（默认/回退）

没有界面设置时，`courseRoot` 取自对应 profile 的 patch（web 示例）：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
- id: ai-courses
  name: dsh-ai-courses
  config:
    courseRoot: /Users/you/Documents/ai-courses
```

桌面端对应 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`。

规则：

- 支持 `~` 展开；展开后必须是**绝对路径**，相对路径会被拒绝。
- patch 里的 `config` 是**整体替换**，不是深合并；插件会自动回填缺省值。
- 改完重启 DSH 生效。
- 一旦在界面里保存过设置，`ai-courses.settings.json` 会覆盖 patch 值；删掉该文件并重启，才会回到 patch 值。
- `maxParallelGenerations`、`defaultContentType` 目前只是配置兼容保留，**不改变运行时行为**，不要把它们当开关。

### 其他

- 插件包名：`dsh-ai-courses`
- bundle patch 行 id：`ai-courses`
- client platform：`web`
- 零运行时依赖；不写会话事件

---

## 数据与备份

### 目录结构

```
<courseRoot>/                         默认 ~/.dsh/ai-courses
└── c-20261013142530-a7f3/            课程 id = 目录名
    ├── course.json                   课程元数据 + 大纲 + schemaVersion
    ├── progress.json                 学习进度（只存知识点层）
    ├── tasks.json                    内容生成任务
    ├── content-assets/
    │   ├── <kpId>.json               内容资产信封（元数据、mediaRefs）
    │   ├── <kpId>.md                 图文正文
    │   ├── <kpId>.slides.md          幻灯片正文
    │   └── media/                    示意图等本地媒体
    └── sources/                      诉求原文与附件副本
        ├── request.md
        └── <附件文件名>
```

- `course.json` 里内联章节与知识点；`progress.json` 只存知识点进度，章节/课程进度由它派生。
- 正文里的媒体引用是**课程目录内的相对路径**，整个课程目录可以搬走。
- 删除课程 = 删除这一个目录，不存在跨系统的非原子删除。

### 备份与迁移

直接复制整个 `<courseRoot>`：

```bash
cp -R ~/.dsh/ai-courses ~/backup/ai-courses-$(date +%F)
```

换机器时把目录拷过去，然后在课程库右上角的配置里把 `courseRoot` 指到新位置（或删掉 `ai-courses.settings.json` 后改 profile patch、重启）。

### 版本与损坏

- 每个结构化 JSON 文件都有 `schemaVersion`；`course.json` / `progress.json` 带版本守卫。
- 如果 `course.json` / `progress.json` 来自**更新版本**的插件，旧代码会**只读降级**：可浏览、禁止写入，不会静默改写你的数据。
- JSON 解析失败时，该文件降级为空，并把原文件另存为 `.corrupt-<时间戳>`，其他课程不受影响。
- 早期版本写入的 SVG 可能不是合法 XML，浏览器不显示。在仓库内跑一次清洗器（会先预演并备份 `.bak`）：

```bash
node scripts/repair-media.mjs --write
```

---

## 升级、停用与卸载

| 场景 | 操作 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 升级（npm） | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ai-courses@latest` | 重启 DSH |
| 升级（市场） | 插件市场 → 更新 | 按提示重启 |
| 升级（本地 link） | `git pull && node scripts/build.mjs` | 重启 DSH |
| 升级（tarball） | 重新 `npm pack` 后 `dsh plugin add` 新 tgz | 重启 DSH |
| 临时停用 | 设置 → 插件 → 关闭 | 界面消失，课程数据保留 |
| 卸载 | 设置 → 插件 → 卸载（推荐）；或 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-ai-courses`，并确认 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里没有残留 | **不会删除课程数据** |
| 删除数据 | 手动删除 `<courseRoot>` | 不可撤销，先备份 |

升级注意：

- **替换已安装包必须重启**才能加载新的 JavaScript 模块；只刷新页面不够。
- slot id 没变不代表浏览器端代码已更新，以重启后的界面为准。
- 升级不会动课程数据；但如果 `schemaVersion` 升了，回滚到旧版本会让数据变成只读（这是刻意的保护）。
- 回滚最快的方式是先在「设置 → 插件」里停用，而不是卸载。

---

## 已知限制

- `音频` / `视频` / `代码` / `测验` 目前只按 Markdown 降级生成，标注「格式待定」。
- `测验` 只展示题目与答案，不能作答判分。
- 音频/视频不做合成，只支持本地挂载素材。
- 课程数据纯本地，没有云同步；换机器需手动拷贝 `courseRoot`。
- 进度是轮询更新（约 1.5s），不是实时推送。
- 内容生成依赖模型与会话；模型不可用时无法生成。
- 幻灯片使用 Slidev 方言，但不是完整的 Slidev 运行时；只支持本插件实现的版式与能力。
- Mermaid 渲染器约 3.4 MB，按需加载；拿不到 vendor 文件时图表会降级成源码块，不会

plugins.readme_text:
# chuanban-dsh-theme

> **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 暖纸阅读与写作外观皮肤插件**  
> *Warm-paper & Anthropic-inspired reading theme for DeepSeek Harness — zero runtime overhead, 66 design tokens, and crisp typography.*

**极简介绍**：船板自用 DSH 仿 Claude Desktop 暖纸外观皮肤。通过官方主题接口将 DSH 默认的高对比工程界面替换为温润耐看的暖白纸色系、纯白浮起输入框与中西文阅读字体栈，只改样式变量，零后台脚本轮询、不卡界面动效。

插件有 2 件套，本仓库为纯外观皮肤（可单独使用），推荐搭配船板的纯净写作协作预设插件 [`chuanban-dsh-writingset`](https://github.com/Anarcadia/chuanban-dsh-writingset) 一同使用。

---

好的写作工具不该像一块冷冰冰的监控仪表盘。

`chuanban-dsh-theme` 是专为长文推敲、文学创作与日常沉浸对话打磨的 DSH 原生客户端皮肤。它将界面从高对比度的工程冷调，整体转换为**暖白纸面（`#FBF9F5`）、燕麦暖灰侧栏（`#F1EEE7`）、温暖炭黑字色（`#2C2B29`）与陶土色视觉焦点（`#D97757`）**，配合带暖光呼吸阴影的纯白输入卡片与三层中西文字体栈，让 DSH 拥有如纸质书页与 Claude Desktop 般安静、扎实的阅读体验。

![chuanban-dsh-theme 暖纸皮肤实机效果](docs/screenshot-preview.png)

---

## 一键安装

### 1. DSH Desktop 桌面端（最简）
打开 **设置 → 插件**，在安装输入框直接粘贴以下 URL：

```text
https://github.com/Anarcadia/chuanban-dsh-theme/releases/latest/download/chuanban-dsh-theme.tgz
```

### 2. DSH CLI 命令行

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Anarcadia/chuanban-dsh-theme/releases/latest/download/chuanban-dsh-theme.tgz
```

- **未全局安装 `dsh` CLI**：将上面的 `dsh` 替换为 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh`：
  ```sh
  npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Anarcadia/chuanban-dsh-theme/releases/latest/download/chuanban-dsh-theme.tgz
  ```
- **连同纯净写作协作预设（[`chuanban-dsh-writingset`](https://github.com/Anarcadia/chuanban-dsh-writingset)）一起装**（一条命令配齐「纯净写作提示词内核 + 暖纸阅读皮肤」）：
  ```sh
  dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Anarcadia/chuanban-dsh-writingset/releases/latest/download/chuanban-dsh-writingset.tgz https://github.com/Anarcadia/chuanban-dsh-theme/releases/latest/download/chuanban-dsh-theme.tgz
  ```

安装后重启 DSH 桌面端（或在插件页刷新）即刻生效；想要临时换回官方原皮，只需在 **插件** 页关闭 `chuanban-dsh-theme` 开关即可**热切换恢复（HMR，无需重启）**。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **⚠️ 完整效果需要安装字体包（免费）**：本皮肤只声明 CSS 字体栈，不内嵌字体文件。**未安装字体时暖纸配色与布局照常生效**，仅中西文字体会回退为系统默认。要获得设计稿级的完整排版（更纱黑体等宽 + Anthropic 风格字栈），请先安装字体包：
>
> **[📦 点此下载字体包（Google Drive 公开分享）](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NX92SgVUqtSjWg6bt6sIJXy-cn7J_boC?usp=drive_link)**
>
> 下载后安装字体（macOS 双击 .ttc / .ttf 导入字体册，Windows 右键安装），重启 DSH 即完整生效。

---

## 视觉与排版设计细节

本插件坚持**「浅度定制、零动效性能负担」**原则——全部通过 DSH 官方 `ctx.theme.overrideTokens('chuanban-skin', ...)` 通道一次性注入 **66 个 `--dsw-*` / `--ds-*` 主题变量**，辅以极薄的 `<style data-plugin>` 全局样式微调，**无任何 `MutationObserver`、`TreeWalker` 或定时轮询**。

### 1. 纸面层次与实色框线
- **三级纸面阶梯**：燕麦暖灰侧栏 `#F1EEE7`（选中态 `#E9E4DA`，并自动中和 macOS 桌面端侧栏自带的紫灰平台混色层）↔ 暖白纸主阅读区 `#FBF9F5` ↔ 纯白输入卡片 `#FFFFFF`。
- **暖光呼吸输入框**：纯白输入卡片通过 `0.67px` 暖灰实边（`#A89F8E`）与双层暖褐细晕浮于主区之上；光标聚焦（`:focus-within`）时以 `0.18s` 曲线平滑绽开陶土色 `3px` 暖光环。
- **框线与深炭字色压实**：摒弃浅底上容易发虚的半透明 `rgba` 边框，采用 `#E4E0D7 → #C6BFAE` 四阶实色暖灰细线；文字采用 `#2C2B29 → #3F3B33` 深炭梯度，让模型名、权限标识等功能性小字依靠字号而非发灰来区分层级。

### 2. 三层中西文字体栈与字号跟随
- **UI 界面层（`--dsw-font-family`）**：`'Anthropic Sans Web', 'PingFang SC', -apple-system, ...` —— 几何感西文搭配温润圆润的苹方中文，微负字距（`-0.01em`）让词组凝聚扎实。
- **正文阅读层**：`'Anthropic Serif Web', 'PingFang SC', serif` —— 对话正文采用板状衬线西文配苹方中文（若 DSH 未来版本更新内部 CSS Modules 哈希，则无害回落至 UI 字体栈）。
- **代码与终端层（`--ds-font-family-code`）**：`'Sarasa Mono Slab SC', '等距更纱黑体 Slab SC', 'SF Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ...` —— 严格 1:2 中西文等宽对齐。
- **全局字号同步**：将侧栏与会话目录树接入官方 `--dsh-content-font-delta` 字号轴，调节字号时侧栏与正文同步缩放。

> **字体前提说明**：插件仅声明 CSS 字体栈（不包含字体体积）。为获得最佳排版效果，建议安装上方 **[📦 字体包（Google Drive）](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NX92SgVUqtSjWg6bt6sIJXy-cn7J_boC?usp=drive_link)**，即 **更纱黑体（`Sarasa Mono Slab SC` / `Sarasa-SuperTTC.ttc`）** 及 **Anthropic Sans / Serif Web** 字体；若未安装，系统将自动平滑回退至 macOS 原生 `PingFang SC`、`SF Mono` 等系统字体，不影响任何配色与布局功能。

---

## 使用建议与设计边界

- **外观模式建议固定为 `Light`（浅色）**：本皮肤专为暖白纸日间沉浸阅读设计，`light` / `dark` 槽位均映射为暖纸色值；在系统暗色偏好下，未覆盖的局部语义状态色（如错误/警告/diff 高亮）会走官方暗色值，因此建议在 DSH 设置中将外观固定为浅色。
- **有意保留的官方边界**：语义状态色（`error / success / warn`）、Toast/Tooltip 深色提示面以及代码 Diff 配色均保留官方默认设计，不做过度侵入。

## 本地开发与自检

```sh
npm run build               # 打包生成 lazy-CJS 格式的 dist/client.js 与 dist/index.js
npm test                    # 运行 31 项自动化校验（Bundle 结构 / 66 个 token 形状 / 关键色值与声明）
npm run install-desktop     # 符号链接注册进本机 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop（供本地开发调试）
```

## 停用与卸载

- **热切换原皮**：在 DSH **插件** 页关闭 `chuanban-dsh-theme` 行开关，界面立即恢复官方默认主题。
- **卸载插件**：
  - **DSH Desktop**：设置 → 插件 → 找到 `chuanban-dsh-theme` 点击卸载。
  - **DSH CLI**：`dsh plugin --profile web remove chuanban-dsh-theme`

## License
