plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Startup Intro · 启动开场动画 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 加一个可自定义视频的启动开场：导入自己的视频素材，选中哪段，之后每次启动就播哪段；片段、速度、亮度、画面适配、影院填充、展示比例与淡出时长都能调，支持实时预览；播完交叉淡出，直接过渡到工作台。动画还会**跟随 DSH 的浅色 / 深色外观自动选版**。 A video-powered boot intro plugin for DeepSeek Harness: import clips, keep per-clip playback settings, preview live in Settings, then cross-fade into the workbench at every launch. Ships with a procedurally generated demo intro (dark & light cuts). ![启动开场](docs/boot.gif)

## 功能 - **视频素材库**：导入本地视频（`mp4` / `webm` / `mov` 等 Chromium 能解码的格式），删除、切换选中；每段素材各自保存一套参数。 - **启动即播**：直接播放原视频（不做 GIF 转换、不重新编码），播完约 0.8–1.2s 交叉淡出露出 DSH 界面；播放中可点击「跳过开场」。 - **参数调节**：起始位置、播放时长、播放速度、亮度、画面适配（铺满 / 完整）、影院填充（用同一段视频的模糊背景补满画面）、展示比例（播到哪一刻开始淡出）、淡出时长、静音。 - **实时预览**：设置页内嵌预览随参数即时变化；「播放完整开场效果」可在全屏跑一遍完整启动流程。 - **深浅色自动切换**：跟随 DSH 的外观（`body[data-ds-dark-theme]`）自动选择深色版 / 浅色版同一素材；设置页预览也会随外观实时换版。 - **数据都在本机**：素材与参数保存在 `~/.dsh/startup-intro/`，卸载插件不会删除素材。 ## 安装 先确认 `dsh` 可用（DeepSeek Harness 自带 CLI，Electron 桌面版安装目录 `resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd`）。 ### 方式一：目录安装（推荐） ```bash git clone https://github.com/zoe1nan/dsh-startup-intro.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-startup-intro ``` ### 方式二：打包安装 ```bash pnpm pack # 或 npm pack，得到 dsh-startup-intro-1.1.0.tgz dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-startup-intro-1.1.0.tgz ``` > 若 pnpm 报 `[ERR_PNPM_UNKNOWN] ... open '.../pnpm/store/...'`，改用目录安装即可绕过（本地 link 依赖）。 安装完成后**重启 DeepSeek Harness**（Electron 桌面版重启才会加载新 bundle）。打开 设置 → 启动开场 即可看到插件页面。 ## 使用 1. 设置（`Ctrl+Alt+,`）→ 左侧「启动开场」。 2. 点「导入视频」，选择本地视频；导入后自动选中，下次启动就播放它。 3. 调整参数——右侧预览实时生效；点「播放完整开场效果」可在全屏看完整流程。 4. 右上「每次启动播放」可临时关闭开场；「恢复默认参数」重置当前素材。 ## 预置演示素材 `demo/` 下是两段程序化生成的示例开场（1920×1080 / 8.8s / 30fps，各 2–3 MB）： | 文件 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `demo/startup-intro-dark.mp4` | 深色外观版：深蓝夜空 + 轨道环 + 原生小蓝鲸 | | `demo/startup-intro-light.mp4` | 浅色外观版：纸面蓝墨 + 同构图的墨色鲸 | 一键写入本机素材库并选中： ```bash node tools/seed-demo.mjs ``` 也可以直接在设置页「导入视频」里选这两个文件。生成源码见 `demo/source/intro-art.html`（`?t=` 可定位到任意帧，`&theme=light` 输出浅色版）。 ## 深浅色自动切换 素材条目支持可选的 `lightFile` 字段（同一素材的浅色版）： ```jsonc // ~/.dsh/startup-intro/state.json { "version": 1, "enabled": true, "selectedId": "v9f2b7c4e1a8d3605c7be", "videos": [ { "id": "v9f2b7c4e1a8d3605c7be", "name": "DEEPSEEK HARNESS 开场.mp4", "file": "v9f2b7c4e1a8d3605c7be.mp4", "lightFile": "v9f2b7c4e1a8d3605c7be-light.mp4", "meta": { "duration": 8.8, "width": 1920, "height": 1080 }, "params": { "start": 0, "duration": 8.8, "speed": 1, "brightness": 1, "fit": "cover", "cinema": true, "holdRatio": 0.83, "fadeMs": 1200, "muted": true } } ] } ``` 把浅色版文件放进 `~/.dsh/startup-intro/media/`，并在对应条目加上 `lightFile` 即可：深色外观播 `file`，浅色外观播 `lightFile`。不填 `lightFile` 时两种外观播放同一文件。 ## 实现 ``` index.js Host 半边：状态 / 上传 / 删除 / 媒体直出路由 client.js Client 半边：启动浮层（shell.overlay）+ 设置页（settings.section） cordis.patch.yml bundle 挂载声明 locale/{zh,en}.json 设置页导航与插件卡片的标题 / 描述 icon.svg 插件图标 demo/ 示例开场素材与生成源码 tools/seed-demo.mjs 把 demo 素材写入本机素材库 ``` - Host：`ctx.webServer.register({ kind: 'prefix', path: '/startup-intro' })` 提供 `GET/POST /api/state`、`POST /api/upload`、`POST /api/delete`、`GET /media/`（支持 `Range` / 206）。 所有请求都会先过 `connection.requestRejection(req)`，未授权直接 401。 - Client：`ctx.slots.inject('shell.overlay', ...)` 注册启动浮层（`createPortal` 到 body，保证盖过启动弹窗）； `ctx.slots.inject('settings.section', ...)` 注册设置页。用 `MutationObserver` 监听 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 切换素材版本。 - 不使用插件 Config 字段：素材与参数放 `~/.dsh/startup-intro/state.json`，由设置页自己读写。 ## 开发与调试 不想污染现有 profile 时，可以起一个独立测试实例： ```bash # 用内置模板建一个独立 profile（与 desktop 隔离） dsh introtest --from-default-profile web --dump-config dsh plugin --profile introtest add /path/to/dsh-startup-intro # 启动测试实例（--no-open 不弹窗，输出带 token 的调试 URL） dsh introtest --no-open --port 63411 # 用完清理 rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/introtest ``` - 改 `client.js` / `index.js`：刷新页面即可生效（客户端 bundle 每次加载时重新取）。 - 改 `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml`：需要重启实例。 示例开场的生成源码在 `demo/source/intro-art.html`：纯 canvas 2D 程序化动画，`?t=<毫秒>` 可定格任意帧，`&theme=light` 输出浅色版。逐帧截图后再用 ffmpeg 编码即可（仓库未附渲染脚本，按你的环境选 Edge headless / Playwright）。 ## 兼容性 - DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（Electron，web profile）实测；Web 版同理，需注意浏览器自动播放策略（默认静音即可自动播放，取消静音后可能被拦截）。 - 视频解码走 Chromium 内置解码器：H.264/AAC 的 mp4 在桌面版可播；是否支持 HEVC/AV1 取决于 Harness 内置 Chromium 构建。 ## 已知限制 - 桌面端**重启 Harness 后**才加载 / 更新插件（插件在启动时装配，不支持运行中热插拔）。 - 素材保存在本机，不随插件同步；换机器需要重新导入。 - 导入文件大小上限 2 GiB（Host 侧限制）。 ## License MIT

plugins.description: bilibili-note 的 DSH 插件封装版（衍生自 3588834014-del/bilibili-note）：把 B站视频链接变成 Obsidian 结构化笔记，只拉字幕不下载视频。
plugins.readme_text:
# bilibili-note

> **DSH plugin packaging of [`3588834014-del/bilibili-note`](https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note).**
>
> This repository is the **plugin edition**: the upstream project plus a DeepSeek Harness
> bundle wrapper (`package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` / `lib/index.js`). The original
> skill + CLI lives upstream — use that one if you don't need to install it as a dsh plugin.
> GitHub does not allow forking a repository into the same account, so this is a derivative
> copy rather than a fork-network fork.

> **Turn Bilibili videos into structured Obsidian notes — subtitles only, never the video.**
>
> 中文说明见 [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)。

[![CI](https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.8+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.8%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

A small CLI — plus an optional agent skill — that turns a Bilibili video into a structured
Markdown note in your Obsidian vault. It downloads **only the subtitle file** (`--skip-download`),
cleans the timestamps, and writes a note with YAML front matter, a summary section, bullet
points carrying clickable `?t=` jump links, and the full transcript collapsed at the bottom.

The repetitive half (fetch, parse, format, verify) is a script. The judgment half (summary,
key points, tags) is left as a documented contract you or an agent fill in.

```
Bilibili URL ──▶ fetch ──▶ manifest.json ──▶ [you / agent] ──▶ content.json ──▶ write ──▶ note.md
                  │         subtitles +                      summary, bullets,       │
                  │         timestamped segments             tags                    │
                  └── yt-dlp, subtitles only ────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Real output

`fetch` on a real video — note what is *not* there: no `.mp4`, `.flv`, `.m4a` or `.part`,
only the subtitle file and its manifest.

![fetch: subtitles only, no media files](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/main/docs/images/demo-fetch.png)

And the note it produces (Obsidian rendering — front matter, clickable `?t=` jump links,
summary, bullets, tags). Screenshot taken from a real run, not a mock-up:

![the generated note](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/main/docs/images/demo-note.png)

## Why this one

- **Subtitles only.** `--skip-download` is mandatory, and the tool verifies no media file
  (`.mp4/.flv/.m4a/.part`) landed in the working directory. No reverse-engineering, no
  private APIs — just `yt-dlp`.
- **Multi-part videos are merged.** For an anthology (B站 分P 合集) it fetches every part's
  subtitles and rebases the timestamps onto one continuous timeline. Verified on a real
  6-part anthology: **2:10:32 → 2807 segments / 33214 characters**, matching an independent
  concatenation segment-for-segment. A part with no subtitles is skipped **while keeping its
  time slot**, so later timestamps stay correct.
- **It refuses to produce garbage.** If two parts yield byte-identical subtitles, it errors out
  instead of silently emitting a note whose content is one part repeated N times. (That exact
  bug shipped during development and was caught by this guard.)
- **No subtitles? It skips and tells you.** It never fabricates content or writes an empty note.

## Install

No dependencies — standard library only. `yt-dlp` is an **external command**, not a Python package.

### As a DSH plugin (recommended for DeepSeek Harness)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:3588834014-del/bilibili-note-plugin
```

This is a **bundle plugin** that registers the `bilibili-note` skill straight into the DSH skill
catalog — no manual copying into `~/.agents/skills`. Restart your profile afterwards and the
skill is available; the model picks it up from phrases like 「B站笔记」 or a pasted BV link.

The plugin ships its own copy of `scripts/bili_note.py`, `docs/` and `SKILL.md`, and rewrites
the `<skill-dir>` placeholders in the skill body to the **absolute install path**, so the model
never has to guess where the script lives. Uninstall with
`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-bilibili-note`.

> There is no npm package yet, so this plugin is **source-installed** — it is listed on
> [dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org) but will not appear in the in-app plugin store.
> pnpm ≥10 may ask you to allow the git dependency's build script; this package has no
> `prepare` script, so nothing runs at install time.

### As a standalone CLI

```bash
pipx install git+https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note.git
# or
git clone https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note.git
cd bilibili-note && python -m pip install .
```

Then:

```bash
bili-note --version
bili-note note "https://www.bilibili.com/video/BVxxxxxxxxx" \
    --note-dir ~/MyVault/Sources/Videos
```

### As a plain agent skill (no plugin)

```bash
python scripts/install.py            # installs to ~/.agents/skills/bilibili-note
python scripts/install.py --dry-run  # show what would be copied
```

The skill then appears in the dsh skill catalog and can be triggered with phrases like
「B站笔记」. The plugin, the skill-file install and the CLI all share the same implementation
(`scripts/bili_note.py`).

### Requirements

| Requirement | Notes |
|---|---|
| Python 3.8+ | stdlib only |
| [`yt-dlp`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) | `pip install -U yt-dlp` — the **only** download channel |
| Bilibili login cookies | Required for AI subtitles; see below |
| DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0` | Only for the plugin/skill route |

### Permissions and external services

Worth knowing before you install, since this tool touches the network and your vault:

- **Network**: talks to `bilibili.com` through `yt-dlp` only. It downloads **subtitles**, never
  video or audio (`--skip-download` is mandatory and verified).
- **Credentials**: reads a Bilibili cookie file from `$BILI_COOKIES` or `./cookies.txt`. It
  writes a **normalized temporary copy** next to the work dir for yt-dlp; it never uploads,
  logs, or commits cookies.
- **Filesystem**: writes notes into the `--note-dir` you pass, plus a scratch work directory.
  Nothing outside those two paths is modified.
- **No telemetry, no extra dependencies**, no reverse-engineered APIs.

## Cookies (required)

Bilibili's AI-subtitle endpoint needs an authenticated session.

1. Install the **Get cookies.txt LOCALLY** browser extension.
2. Log into [bilibili.com](https://www.bilibili.com).
3. Export `cookies.txt`.
4. Put it in your working directory, or point at it:

```bash
export BILI_COOKIES=/path/to/cookies.txt      # Linux / macOS
$env:BILI_COOKIES = "C:\path\cookies.txt"     # PowerShell
```

Videos where the uploader supplied their own subtitles may work without this.

### ⚠️ Why you can't feed the export straight to yt-dlp

This is the single most surprising thing in this repository. That extension writes lines like:

```
.bilibili.com	FALSE	/	FALSE	1819635894	SESSDATA	xxxxx
```

The domain carries a leading dot, yet the host-only flag in column 2 is `FALSE`. Python's
`http.cookiejar` asserts:

```python
assert domain_specified == initial_dot
```

The mismatch raises, and yt-dlp refuses to load the **entire file**:

```
ERROR: invalid Netscape format cookies file '...': '.bilibili.com\tFALSE\t/...'
```

The practical symptom is nasty: subtitles never arrive, and the error looks like
*"this video has no subtitles."* The fix is normalization — strip the leading dot and set the
flag to `FALSE` (a host-only cookie is still sent to `api.bilibili.com` and friends, so the
session is preserved). `normalize_cookies()` does this, plus filters to the `bilibili` domain
and de-duplicates by `domain/path/name`. You never have to do it by hand.

## Output directory

Nothing is hard-coded. Pick either:

```bash
bili-note note "<URL>" --note-dir "<vault>/Sources/Videos"    # explicit

export BILI_VAULT="/path/to/MyVault"                           # or environment
export BILI_TARGET_DIR="Sources/Videos"

plugins.description: 复杂项目模式 preset for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the standard tool stack plus a four-document policy, current-state-only docs, a no-unrequested-push rule, careful coding, and plain-language reporting.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-complex-project-preset

**An agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): the full standard tool stack, plus the discipline to think before it types.**

> 中文版: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

The whole preset lives in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml): it inserts one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row into the profile and registers a preset with the id `complex-project`. The package ships **configuration only** — no host code, no browser UI — so there is very little that an upgrade can break.

---

## Why

The standard preset gets work done, but it will not hold a line on its own: diffs creep, project docs turn into changelogs, and code goes up before you said so.

This preset writes four rules into the persona prompt, so every session starts with them already in force:

| Rule | In one line |
| --- | --- |
| Four documents | A project keeps at most four docs: intro, decisions, change log, current state & next steps |
| Current state only | No AI edit history, no superseded decisions, no leftover "stage 1–5" wording |
| Commit/push red line | No `git commit`, `git push`, or PR until you explicitly say so |
| Careful coding + plain language | Restate the goal and the done-criteria first, make surgical diffs, lead reports with the conclusion |

## What's inside

The tool stack matches the standard preset — bash/pwsh chosen per platform, file read/write and search, tasks and background jobs, skills, plan mode, compaction, subagents and workflows, web fetch, the TODO tool, present. What differs is the persona prompt and the documentation rules:

- `persona` — the four-document policy, current-state-only docs, the commit/push red line, the careful-coding rules, and plain-language reporting;
- `agent-instructions` — still loads your global `AGENTS.md` (64 KB cap);
- `planning` / `compaction` / `delegation` — same groups and isolation settings as standard;
- `tool-plugin-manager` — disabled, so the agent cannot rewrite its own plugin tree.

> ⚠️ The persona block deliberately sets **no `suffix`**. DSH registers only `provider` and `model` as prompt variables; any other `{{name}}` throws during prompt assembly and the whole turn fails before a single request is sent. The working directory is injected by the runtime context already, so declaring it here is redundant as well as fatal.

## Install

```sh
# from npm (recommended — prebuilt install, no build approval)
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-complex-project-preset

# or from the repository / a local directory
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/sueqet/dsh-complex-project-preset
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<local-dir>
```

**Restart the profile** (run `dsh web` again, or restart the desktop app) — a preset is a row in the profile composition, not a runtime hot-load.

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-complex-project-preset`

### Conflicts with a hand-rolled copy

If your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` already declares `- id: preset-complex-project` by hand, installing this package registers the same preset twice and DSH reports `Duplicate agent preset: complex-project`. To switch over:

1. delete that `- id: preset-complex-project ...` block from your `cordis.patch.yml`;
2. `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-complex-project-preset`;
3. restart the profile.

Only one package should provide `complex-project` at a time.

### Version requirement

Requires **DSH ≥ 0.1.7-rc.2** (the preset registry `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry` joins the base composition there) and **Node.js ≥ 22.19.0**. Verified on DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 and on the desktop build 0.2.1-rc.2.

The Node floor is the harness's own rather than this package's: DSH compositions call `process.getBuiltinModule`, which Node ships from 22.3 onwards. This package is a manifest plus one YAML patch — no host code, no browser code, no install-time scripts — so it never loads JavaScript of its own, and the floor only mirrors where DSH can run at all.

## Verify

After a restart, open the mode picker for a new session: **复杂项目模式** (order 2, right after the standard preset) should be listed. Start a session with it and ask about the project's current state — the answer should talk in terms of the four documents rather than freeform.

From the CLI you can also inspect the composed tree:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 preset-complex-project
```

## Develop

```sh
npm test          # checks manifest + cordis.patch.yml consistency, including !!js parsing
npm pack --dry-run
```

`tools/smoke.mjs` verifies that `dsh.bundle.patch` points at a file that exists, that `repository` points back at this repo, that every required preset field is present, that child row ids are unique, and that the persona prompt is neither truncated nor carrying a stray `suffix`. It parses the patch with the harness's own `loadOverlayPatches` when available, so `!!js` expressions behave exactly as they do at boot.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 sueqet

plugins.description: bioRxiv preprint search, version/status and export tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-biorxiv

bioRxiv preprint search, version/publication status and export tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Zero runtime dependencies.

> Status: `0.1.0-alpha` — functional core, not a 1.0 release. Relevance evaluation is provisional; do not treat it as peer-reviewed evidence.

## Tools

- `biorxiv_search` — search bioRxiv preprints by topic, optional date window and field. Default `minScore=3` filters low-confidence text matches; set `minScore=0` for higher recall.
- `biorxiv_paper` — DOI lookup: latest version, publication DOI/journal, retraction flag when available.
- `biorxiv_latest` — latest preprints by date window and optional category.
- `biorxiv_export` — export search results or one DOI as JSON, Markdown, CSV or BibTeX.
- `biorxiv_digest` — structured markdown digest (extractive by default; optional opt-in Chinese summaries; no automatic delivery).

All tools return a stable envelope:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {},
  "error": { "code": "", "message": "", "retryable": false, "hint": "" },
  "meta": { "requestId": "...", "elapsedMs": 12, "cached": false, "source": ["europepmc"], "warnings": [] }
}
```

On failure `ok` is `false`, `data` is `{}`, and `error.code` is one of `E-001`–`E-010`.

## Install (one command)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile headless add github:TYEclipse/dsh-biorxiv#v0.1.0-alpha.20
```

Replace `headless` with the target profile. `dsh plugin add` is a pnpm forwarder: a `--profile` is required, and `pnpm` must be on `PATH`.

Build from source instead:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile headless add "file:$PWD/$(ls -t dsh-biorxiv-*.tgz | head -1)"
```

Verify:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile headless list
dsh --profile headless "Use biorxiv_search to search for 'protein language model' and report the first title and DOI."
```

`dsh plugin add` is a pnpm forwarder: a `--profile` is required, and `pnpm` must be on `PATH`.

## CLI

```bash
dsh-biorxiv search "protein language model" --limit 5
dsh-biorxiv paper 10.64898/2026.07.21.739963
dsh-biorxiv latest --days 2 --limit 10
dsh-biorxiv export "hippocampal ripple" --format markdown --out refs.md
dsh-biorxiv digest "protein language model" --limit 5
```

Each command prints one JSON envelope and exits `0` on success, `1` on a tool error, `2` on a usage error.

## MCP

Run the stdio server:

```bash
dsh-biorxiv-mcp
```

MCP client config example:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "biorxiv": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "--package", "dsh-biorxiv", "dsh-biorxiv-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

An npm package is not published yet. The `npx` form above works after publication; for a GitHub install, point the client at `node ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-biorxiv/dist/apps/mcp/main.js`.

The server exposes `biorxiv_search`, `biorxiv_paper`, `biorxiv_latest`, `biorxiv_export` and `biorxiv_digest` with the same JSON envelope.

## Configuration

Defaults live in the plugin schema; no config is required.

```json
{
  "cachePath": "~/.cache/dsh-biorxiv/cache.db",
  "cacheMode": "auto",
  "timeoutMs": 10000,
  "retries": 2,
  "maxBytes": 2000000,
  "userAgent": "dsh-biorxiv/0.1 (DeepSeek Harness plugin)",
  "summaryEnabled": false,
  "summaryModel": "deepseek-chat",
  "summaryBaseUrl": "https://api.deepseek.com",
  "summaryApiKeyEnv": "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"
}
```

- `summaryEnabled`: default `false`. When true, `digest --summary` sends only public title/abstract to the configured model and labels output as machine-generated.
- The API key is read from the named environment variable; it is never written to config, cache or logs.
- CLI: `dsh-biorxiv digest "topic" --summary` opts in; it also enables the provider for that process.
- MCP: set `DSH_BIORXIV_SUMMARY=1` in the server environment, then call `biorxiv_digest` with `summary: true`.

- `cacheMode`: `auto` (SQLite when available, JSON fallback), `sqlite`, or `json`.
- Cache keys are SHA-256 hashes; query text is not written into the cache key.
- Delete the cache file to reset; it is disposable.

## Data sources and boundaries

- Search: Europe PMC REST (`SRC:PPR` + `PUBLISHER:"bioRxiv"`).
- Latest/version details: bioRxiv public API.
- Journal/retraction enrichment: Crossref and OpenAlex; failures are non-blocking.
- No full-text PDF download, no scraping behind 403/paywalls, no writes to source sites.
- Do not use for clinical, medical or investment decisions. Preprints are not peer-reviewed.

## Development

```bash
pnpm test
pnpm coverage
```

The coverage ratchet is enforced by `scripts/coverage-ratchet.mjs`; line coverage must not fall below `.coverage-baseline.json`.

## License

MIT. See `LICENSE`. Privacy and data flow: see `PRIVACY.md`.

plugins.description: Deterministic financial-data and valuation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: six ratio groups, forecast ratios, DCF slots, comparable PS/PE, IRR — one unified schema.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-valuation-service

A deterministic financial-data and valuation plugin for **DeepSeek Harness**. It reads a workpaper layout of `01.json` / `02.json` / `04.json`, computes six ratio groups, forecast ratios, DCF input slots, comparable PS / PE and IRR, and writes one unified schema per project set.

It registers one agent tool, **`valuation_service`**. No AI inference, no invented numbers: anything missing is left blank and marked `missing` for a human or a downstream research step to fill.

## What it computes

| Block | Content |
|---|---|
| `ratios.historical` | profitability, solvency, efficiency, cash flow, valuation, growth |
| `ratios.forecast` | forecast-period profitability / growth / expense; BS- and CF-dependent ratios marked missing |
| `dcf` | full input slots (WACC, g, tax, EBIT, D&A, capex, ΔWC, net debt), outputs, missing list, hand-off anchors |
| `comparable` | PS and PE in parallel: trimmed mean, all-sample mean, 1-year mean, pre-money multiple, premium |
| `irr` | target / conservative / optimistic, closed-vs-open judgement, deviation |
| `assumption_diff` | material assumptions vs assumptions computed from actuals, field by field |
| `pending` / `gate` | unresolved conflicts and C2–C7 gate status when the workpapers carry them |

## Input layout

```text
<base>/
├── 项目A/
│   └── json/
│       ├── 01.json   # financial.raw (BS/IS/CF) + financial.ratios
│       ├── 02.json   # assumptions.forecast + assumptions.comparables + assumptions.valuation
│       └── 04.json   # validation.irr_recompute
└── 项目B/
    └── json/...
```

`--base` defaults to `$DSH_VALUATION_BASE` or `./数据底表`. Projects are discovered dynamically: every directory with all three JSON files is included. No project list is hard-coded.

`01.json` may use either `raw = {bs, is, cf}` or report-title sections (e.g. `"一、资产负债表 · 资产"`); both are normalized.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/zirscard/dsh-valuation-service
```

Or from a local directory:

```bash
dsh plugin add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-valuation-service
```

Restart DSH; a new session gets the `valuation_service` tool.

## Tool usage

```json
{
  "base": "/path/to/数据底表",
  "projects": "项目A,项目B",
  "write": true
}
```

- `base` (string, optional): workpaper root; relative paths resolve against the session working directory.
- `projects` (string or array, optional): restrict to these project directory names.
- `write` (boolean, optional, default `false`): write `<base>/valuations-service.json`.
- `out` (string, optional): override the output path.

The tool returns a per-project summary (DCF status and missing list, PS/PE status, IRR closed flag, assumption-diff count, gate) plus the output path.

## CLI usage

The Python entry point is usable without DSH (standard library only):

```bash
python3 core/valuation_service.py --base /path/to/数据底表 --dry-run
python3 core/valuation_service.py --base /path/to/数据底表 --projects 项目A
python3 core/valuation_service.py --base /path/to/数据底表 --write
python3 core/valuation_service.py --base /path/to/数据底表 --write --json
```

`--json` prints one machine-readable summary object; `--write` writes the aggregate file; without `--write` it is a dry run.

## Unified schema

```json
{
  "schema": "m1.valuation-service/v2",
  "project_id": "...",
  "project_name": "...",
  "currency": "CNY",
  "method": "...",
  "financial_inputs": {"period": "...", "is": {}, "bs": {}, "cf": {}},
  "ratios": {"historical": {}, "forecast": {}},
  "dcf": {"status": "computed|partial|unavailable", "inputs": {}, "outputs": {}, "missing": [], "m3_handoff": {}},
  "comparable": {"ps": {}, "pe": {}},
  "irr": {"target": null, "conservative": null, "optimistic": null, "closed": false, "judge": "", "dev": null},
  "assumption_diff": [],
  "pending": [],
  "gate": {}
}
```

The aggregate file wraps records as `{"schema": "m1.valuation-service/aggregate/v2", "generated_at": "...", "base": "...", "projects": [...], "errors": [...]}`.

## Formulas

- Ratios: gross / operating / net margin, ROE, ROA; current / quick / cash ratio, debt-to-equity, debt-to-assets, interest coverage; asset / inventory / receivables turnover and days; OCF ratios; PS / PE / EV / EV-EBITDA; revenue and net-income growth.
- DCF: `FCFF = EBIT × (1 − t) + D&A − capex − ΔWC`; `TV = FCFF_last × (1 + g) / (WACC − g)`; `EV = Σ PV(FCFF) + PV(TV)`; `equity = EV − net debt`.
- Comparable: trimmed mean (10% each side when n ≥ 5), all-sample mean, 1-year mean, pre-money multiple, premium.
- IRR: `(exit value / invested capital) ^ (1 / years) − 1`.
- Assumption diff: material assumption vs module-computed actual, per field.

Ratio formulas are adapted from [anthropics/claude-cookbooks · analyzing-financial-statements/calculate_ratios.py](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-cookbooks/blob/main/skills/custom_skills/analyzing-financial-statements/calculate_ratios.py) (MIT), mapped onto Chinese three-statement labels.

## Adaptation layer

Data variants are handled in one place instead of per project:

| Variant | Function | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| raw layout (`{bs,is,cf}` vs report-title sections) | `_normalize_raw` | normalize by 资产负债表 / 利润表 / 现金流量表 keywords |
| units (thousand / ten-thousand / million CNY) | `_unit_for` | field-name suffix first, then `forecast.unit` |
| field-name variants | `_find_param` | keyword match + exclusion words |
| total vs line item (`资产总计` vs `流动资产合计`) | `_find_val` | totals require an exact match, no substring fallback |
| self-comparison in the comp set | `_included` | drop rows whose `treatment` says 自比 / 剔除 |
| no market PE multiple | `comparable.pe.status=assumption` | use the assumption range explicitly, never present it as a market multiple |

If a new variant is structural (layout / unit / naming), add it to the adapter. If it is a measurement convention, add it to the skill formulas. If data is missing, leave it blank and mark `missing`.

## DCF hand-off

Missing DCF inputs stay blank; `dcf.m3_handoff.anchors` lists what each one needs:

| Missing input | Anchor to fill |
|---|---|
| WACC | risk-free rate / beta / equity risk premium / capital structure |
| g | long-run GDP growth / industry terminal growth |
| capex | capex plan / construction in progress / capacity expansion |
| D&A | depreciation and amortization policy |
| ΔWC | receivables / inventory / payables turnover forecast |
| tax rate | effective tax rate |
| net debt | interest-bearing debt − cash |

## Test

```bash
python3 test/run_tests.py
```

The test builds a synthetic three-project workpaper set in a temporary directory (no client data), runs the service, and checks ratio values, DCF missing slots, comparable status, IRR and the written aggregate file.

## Boundaries

- No AI inference, no model calls, no network requests.
- No client data or project names are shipped in this repository.
- Missing inputs are marked, not fabricated.
- It does not replace a valuation model: it standardizes inputs and keeps the slots.

## License

MIT. Ratio formulas adapted from anthropics/claude-cookbooks (MIT); see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: turn sidebar entries into a compact icon row, with adjustable icon size and per-entry visibility.
plugins.readme_text:
# 侧栏图标并列（sidebar-icon-row）

DeepSeek Harness 插件的侧栏入口默认都是 42px 整行，所以「插件广场 / 远程控制 / 面板入口」会一条一行。
本插件把它们压成 36×36 的图标方块并排显示，并提供设置页。

- 面板入口（`sidebar.panellist`）与底部入口（`sidebar.footer.action`）统一处理；
- 「今日 / 余额」卡片仍独占一整行（沿用 cost-meter 自己的 `.cm-footer-stack`）；
- 每个入口只显示图标，常驻文字隐藏，悬停时在图标上方显示名称（纯 CSS `::after` + `aria-label`）；
- 侧栏收起成 56px 轨道时保持原样（图标竖排）；
- 底部新增一个「设置」齿轮入口，一键打开 DSH 设置页；
- 设置页里可调图标大小（16 / 18 / 20 / 24）、逐个开关入口、并调整图标先后顺序。

## 实现方式

- 只注入一个 `<style>` 节点，不修改任何宿主或其他插件的组件；
- 选择器用 `[data-slot="sidebar.footer.action"] > *` 与 `[class*="panelList"]` / `[class*="panelRow"]` 锚定，
  不使用 `_2H3hWW_` 这类带构建哈希的类名；
- 侧栏入口按渲染出来的名字（`aria-label` 优先）打上 `data-sir-key`，隐藏与排序都作用在这个属性上，
  关闭的入口直接 `display: none !important`（内联），所以不依赖选择器优先级；
- 排序通过给每个入口写 `order` 实现，不移动 DOM；
- 设置存在浏览器 `localStorage`（键 `dsh.sidebar-icon-row.v1`），按浏览器各自保存。

## 设置页

`插件 → 已安装插件 → 侧栏图标并列`。设置区注册在 `plugins.bundle.config`（key 为包名），
在插件页描述下方、插件行上方渲染。

## 安装 / 卸载

```powershell
# 安装（当前 profile；源码就放在 profile 的 local-plugins 下，不依赖工作区）
dsh plugin install "E:\DeepseekHarness-data\data\profiles\desktop\local-plugins\sidebar-icon-row"
# 卸载
dsh plugin remove dsh-sidebar-icon-row
```

安装后刷新页面；新增 bundle 首次加载可能需要重启一次 `dsh web`。

## 回滚

在插件管理里关掉「侧栏图标并列」，或卸载本包：样式随 `<style>` 清理消失，
额外的「设置」图标随 `sidebar.footer.action` 的注册一并移除。

plugins.description: 策略声明 vs 实际执行：说好不干的事干了没，干了的有没有说
plugins.readme_text: # @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-policy [![dshfind 收录](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) **说好不干的事干了没，干了的有没有说。** **关键词**：策略声明 · agent 权限 · 一致性核对 · 不出网 · 通配符放权 · 人工确认 · 过度代理 · 最小权限 --- ## 先说清楚它是什么、不是什么 **是**：把项目的**策略声明**和**实际代码**摆在一起比 —— 策略文件（`policy.yml` / `agent.yml` / 权限配置）写了什么，代码里是不是真的那么干。 **不是**： - ❌ **不是运行时拦截** —— 不拦请求、不挡工具调用，只做静态比对 - ❌ **不是权限扫描器** —— 单看「权限是不是太宽」是 `dsh-agent-scope` 的活；这里只问「和声明对得上吗」 - ❌ **不是合规认证** —— 不判断你能不能过审 - ❌ **不下「安全 / 不安全」的结论** —— 只列事实：声明说 A，代码里是 B **一句话分界**： ``` agent-scope = 单看【权限本身】宽不宽（通配符、根目录、无限制出网） agent-policy = 看【声明】与【实现】是否一致 —— 说好不干的事干了没 ``` 同一个 `allow: "*"`，两边都可能提；但 agent-scope 说的是「这权限太宽」，agent-policy 说的是「你声明了允许一切，而你大概以为自己在声明白名单」。 --- ## 它查什么（5 条） | 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 | |---|---|---| | `POLICY-EGRESS-PROMISE` | 策略里写了「不出网」，同一项目里却有网络调用 | 🔴 | | `POLICY-CONFIRM-MISSING` | 代码里写着「需人工确认」，同一文件里却直接执行高风险动作 | 🔴 | | `POLICY-WILDCARD-ALLOW` | 策略里把权限写成通配符（`allow: "*"` / `tools: ["*"]` / `permissions: all`）| 🔴 | | `POLICY-DECL-EMPTY` | 策略声明里的工具清单是空的（`tools: []` / `tools: null`）| 🟡 | | `POLICY-NO-DECLARATION` | 有 agent 代码（调模型 / 工具）却找不到任何策略声明文件 | 🟡 | **每条都会给出：哪个文件、第几行、那行长什么样、依据是哪条标准。** ### 第 5 条为什么带 `when` `POLICY-NO-DECLARATION` 是「找不到」类判据，如果对所有项目都跑，一个只有 `index.js` 的普通小工具也会被报「没有策略声明」——那是误报。所以它只在项目里出现 agent 特征时才跑：`openai` / `anthropic` / `@deepseek-ai` / `tool_call` / `tool_use` / `AgentExecutor` 等。看到 `notApplicable` 里有它，说明这个项目没有 agent 代码，本来就不该跑。 --- ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-policy ``` ## 用法 ```bash # 核对一个项目 dsh-agent-policy --root /path/to/your-agent # 看内置演示（一个「策略说不出网、代码里却在往外发」的假项目） dsh-agent-policy --demo # 列出规则与依据 dsh-agent-policy --list-rules # 出 HTML 报告 / 给 CI 用 dsh-agent-policy --root . --html dsh-agent-policy --root . --json ``` 退出码：有 high 命中 → `1`（可以挂 CI 卡口）。 --- ## 一个例子 `policy.yml` 里写着： ```yaml outbound: allow: false note: 本 agent 不出网，只访问内网工单库 ``` 而 `src/sync.js` 里： ```js const WEBHOOK = 'https://hooks.slack.com/services/T000/B000/XXXX'; export async function pushSummary(items) { const res = await fetch(WEBHOOK, { ... }); } ``` 报出来是这样： ``` POLICY-EGRESS-PROMISE src/sync.js:9 策略里写明了不准出网，同一个项目里却有网络调用 ``` **注意**：这不是说「出网就有罪」。是说到时候出事，大家会拿着这份 `policy.yml` 说「我们规定了不出网」——而实际上它在出。改代码或者改声明，让两边对上，是这份报告唯一的诉求。 --- ## 判据出处 - **OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 · LLM06 Excessive Agency** —— 智能体的能力应与其声明的边界一致；human-in-the-loop 控制 - **CIS Controls v8 · Control 6（Access Control Management）** —— 授权必须显式列出，最小权限 - **NIST AI RMF 1.0 · GOVERN 1.1 / 1.2、MANAGE 2.2、MAP 1.1** —— AI 系统的策略、责任与边界应明确且与执行一致 - **NIST SP 800-53 Rev.5 · AC-6 Least Privilege** --- ## 双向验证 ```bash bash tests/run.sh ``` - 正例 `tests/fixtures/fail/demo-project/`：一个有策略文件、但代码处处和它拧着的客服 agent - 反例 `tests/fixtures/pass/clean-project/`：策略和实现逐条对得上的项目 - 空缺样本 `tests/fixtures/absent/minimal/`：有 agent 代码、完全没有策略文件 ## 许可 MIT --- ## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 38 个） > 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。 **国内合规**（12）｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling) **AI 与 Agent 治理**（6）｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard) **数据与凭据**（5）｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan) **供应链与构建**（5）｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [物料清单](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom) **权限与应急**（3）｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package) **行业专项**（4）｜ [医疗行业专项](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-industry-medical) · [教育行业专项](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-industry-education) · [金融行业专项](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-industry-finance) · [地方数据条例](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-local-regulation) **编排与交付**（3）｜ [一键体检](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-guard-suite) · [改前改后复核](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-fix-verify) · [合规可交付文档](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-compliance-doc) 都在 DSH 插件市场（dsh-plugin.org）、npm 和 deepwhale.org.cn/guard.html 上。 ---

plugins.description: System monitor overlay for DeepSeek Harness: a corner pill showing live CPU and memory, expanding into disk activity and throughput, per-volume capacity, network state, uptime and battery. Windows collector.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-windows-monitor

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

[![CI](https://github.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-windows-monitor/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-windows-monitor/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

A system monitor overlay for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): a compact pill in the bottom-right corner showing live CPU and memory, expanding into a detail card with disk activity and throughput, per-volume capacity, network state, uptime and battery.

Runs on **Windows**.

![Collapsed and expanded states](https://unpkg.com/dsh-windows-monitor/docs/preview.png)

## Features

- **Never covers the middle.** Collapsed it is a ~210 px pill; expanded it is a 280 px card. It sits clear of the composer by default.
- **Draggable.** Drag the pill or the card header anywhere; the position is clamped to the viewport and remembered. A reset control returns it to the corner.
- **Live at a glance.** The status dot is colour-coded — green nominal, amber elevated, pulsing red for collection failure.
- **Detail on demand.** CPU, memory and **disk activity** as bars, plus one row per volume, a memory total, adapter state, uptime and battery.
- **Capacity and activity are never conflated.** The 磁盘 gauge is *busy time* — the same figure as Task Manager's own 磁盘 column, computed as `100 − PercentIdleTime`. Fullness is a separate per-volume row. A static "93% full" number sitting next to a live CPU reading reads as a stuck or broken dial, so it is never what the gauge shows.
- **Unknown is a real state.** Disk activity is best-effort: with no performance-counter provider, or before the first sample, the panel renders `--` rather than `0%`. A zero would be a claim about an idle disk that nothing actually measured.
- **Honest failure states.** A failed collection shows "unavailable" in the pill instead of stale numbers; a platform with no collector says so explicitly rather than looking broken.
- **Theme-native.** Every colour is a DSH theme token, so light and dark mode follow the app. Icons are inline SVG from the harness's own icon set — no icon fonts.
- **Accessible.** Real buttons with labels, visible focus rings, and animations disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the **Web** profile and the current profile-bundle system.
- **Windows.** The host process must be running on Windows; see [Platform support](#platform-support).
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (to build from source).

No administrator rights are needed, and nothing is installed system-wide.

## Platform support

Windows only, and that is deliberate. The plugin is named for Windows, its headline reading (disk activity) comes from a Windows performance counter, and a collector the maintainer cannot run is a collector whose bugs they cannot reproduce. Shipping Linux and macOS collectors that were written from documentation — and that the author could never exercise on their own hardware — traded a promise the project could not keep for two code paths it could not maintain.

The host picks the collector from `process.platform`, never from the request.

| Platform | Collector |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | PowerShell + CIM/WMI (`Win32_Processor`, `Win32_OperatingSystem`, `Win32_LogicalDisk`, `Win32_Battery`, `Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfDisk_PhysicalDisk`) and `Get-NetAdapter`. Verified by the author on Windows 11 |
| **Anything else** | None. The route answers `501` with an explicit unsupported-platform body, and the panel renders that instead of empty gauges |

`linux` and `macOS` collectors did ship in `0.1.0`; they were removed in `0.2.0`. See the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md).

CI still runs on all three runners, and that is also deliberate. `windows-latest` exercises the collector for real, while `ubuntu-latest` and `macos-latest` prove the negative contract: with no collector the plugin must answer the error rather than pretend. See [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml).

Known limitations:

- Disk activity needs the Windows performance-counter provider. On a host where it is disabled or missing, the reading degrades to `--` instead of failing the snapshot.
- The collector pins the process culture to invariant. The fact format is `key=value` with `.` as the decimal separator, so a comma-decimal locale would otherwise emit unparseable numbers.
- Some drivers report `PercentDiskTime` several times above 100, which is why busy time is derived from the idle complement instead.

## Install

From npm — prebuilt, and the only path that needs no build permission:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-windows-monitor
```

From a local checkout — this is the path to use while developing:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\path\to\dsh-windows-monitor
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # confirm the windows-monitor row is composed
dsh --profile web
```

From a release tarball (prebuilt, no build permission needed):

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add .\dsh-windows-monitor-<version>.tgz
```

From a pinned source tag — see [releases](https://github.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-windows-monitor/releases) for the current one:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:joyboy-yy/dsh-windows-monitor#v0.2.1
```

A git install fetches source and runs this package's `prepare` build, which means package code executes on your machine outside the agent sandbox. pnpm refuses that until the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` explicitly allows it:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-windows-monitor: true
```

Read the source and pin a tag before granting that. A release tarball ships prebuilt files and needs no such permission.

## Configuration

This bundle inserts one Host/Client row, declared in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: windows-monitor
      name: dsh-windows-monitor
      inject: [shell, sandboxPolicy, webServer]
```

Override that row in your profile or home `cordis.patch.yml` to disable it or change its position in the tree.

Browser-local preferences are limited to one value: the dragged panel position, stored under the `dsh-windows-monitor:position` `localStorage` key. It is written only when you drag the panel and removed when you press reset. The plugin stores no metrics.

## How it works

The **Host half** registers one read-only route and runs the collector for its own platform through the harness `shell` service:

```
GET /api/windows-monitor/snapshot
```

The collector prints one `key=value` fact per line. A line format — rather than JSON — is deliberate: emitting correct JSON from PowerShell without assuming a JSON library is a portability trap, whereas `key=value` is trivial to produce and trivial to parse (and unit-test) on the TypeScript side. The host converts facts into the snapshot the client renders and stamps the timestamp itself.

The shell seam is driven through **both** of its entry points. DSH renamed `ctx.shell.run(spec)` to `ctx.shell.execute(spec)`, which resolves with a handle whose `result()` carries the outcome, so the host prefers `execute` and falls back to `run`. Hard-coding either one breaks the plugin on the harness versions that expose the other — `0.2.3` did exactly that and answered every poll with `ctx.shell.run is not a function`. `tests/collectors.test.ts` now covers both, plus a seam with neither.

Results are cached for 5 seconds, and concurrent polls share a single in-flight collection instead of racing, so the browser's polling never multiplies collector runs.

The **Client half** registers into the frame-wide `shell.overlay` slot. That layer is click-through by design — the panel opts into pointer events, so it never blocks the app underneath.

Neither half touches the model, the session, or the transcript. The plugin registers no tools.

## Security model

Read this before installing.

- **The collector is read-only.** It reads CIM/WMI and runs `Get-NetAdapter`. Nothing writes, installs, or changes machine state.
- **The sandbox grant is broad.** The Host half resolves the `danger-full-access` sandbox policy so the shell ca

plugins.description: Simple notepad plugin for DeepSeek Harness: record short notes in a global ($DSH_HOME) or project (<projectRoot>/.dsh) level
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-notepad

[![dsh-plugin topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topics-dsh--plugin-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-notepad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-notepad)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)

一个简易的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：记录短笔记，并按「全局级 / 项目级」分开存放。

## 特性

- 三个模型可调用工具：`notepad_add`、`notepad_list`、`notepad_clear`
- 一个人类斜杠命令：`/note`（没有命令注册表的部署会自动跳过）
- 一个图形面板：侧边栏「速记」图标 → 中央主面板，增删改查 + 跟随当前会话
- 笔记以 JSON Lines 明文保存，可直接 `cat` / 搜索 / 纳入 git
- 零运行时依赖、零构建步骤：只用 Node 内置模块 + DSH 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`

## 安装

包声明了 `dsh.bundle`，所以它是一个**组合包**（bundle）：`dsh plugin add` 装进某个 profile 后，`cordis.patch.yml` 这一层会自动激活（按包名解析插件入口）。

```sh
# 从 npm
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-notepad

# 或直接从 GitHub 源码装（纯 JS、无构建步骤，不会触发 pnpm 的构建授权）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:qux-bbb/dsh-plugin-notepad

# 只验证这一层、不启动
dsh --profile desktop --dump-config     # 应能看到 "# == dsh-plugin-notepad" 这一层

# 卸载
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-notepad
```

> 用 git 装请锁定 commit（`github:qux-bbb/dsh-plugin-notepad#<sha>`），避免后续推送悄悄改变实际运行的内容。

### 手动安装器

仓库自带 `scripts/install-notepad.mjs`，把包装进 `<profile>/plugins/notepad/` 并往 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 写一个受标记包围的区块。它幂等、改动前备份、`--uninstall` 只删自己写入的区块，适合 `desktop` 这类 `dsh plugin` 不便处理的 profile：

```powershell
$node = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe"

& $node scripts\install-notepad.mjs --profile desktop             # 装到当前 desktop profile
& $node scripts\install-notepad.mjs --scope home                  # 或装到全局（$DSH_HOME），对所有 profile 生效
& $node scripts\install-notepad.mjs --profile desktop --dry-run   # 先看看会改什么
& $node scripts\install-notepad.mjs --profile desktop --uninstall # 卸载
```

生效方式：DSH 的分层顺序是 `bundle 补丁 → profile 的 cordis.patch.yml → $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml → --patch`。补丁文件的改动会被热重载；但已变成 `inactive` 且配置未变的条目宿主不会重试，此时改一次配置值或重启应用。

## 使用

### 工具

| 工具 | 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notepad_add` | `content`（必填）、`tags?`、`scope?` | 记一条，正文自动 trim，标签去重 |
| `notepad_list` | `scope?`、`query?`、`limit?` | 新的在前；省略 `scope` = 合并所有启用层级；`query` 对正文 / 标签 / id 做子串过滤 |
| `notepad_clear` | `scope`（必填）、`confirm: true`（必填） | 清空指定层级（破坏性） |

`notepad_add` 返回 `{ id, at, scope, tags, content, file, total }`：

```
Noted p-mv6ieauq-01fmiy at 2026-10-13T09:59:19.922Z in the project notepad (3 note(s) there).
File: D:\work\repo\.dsh\notepad\notes.jsonl
```

### `/note` 命令

- `/note 记一条内容` → 新增一条（走默认层级）
- `/note`（不带内容）→ 列出最近 5 条

### 图形面板

侧边栏底部的 **速记** 图标（`sidebar.panellist`，order 40）会在中央主面板（`main`）打开完整界面：

- **跟随当前会话**：点开就是当前会话所在项目的 notepad；下拉可临时切到别的项目，「跟随会话」按钮一键切回，切换会话后 1.5s 内自动跟随。
- **两个层级标签页**：`项目` / `全局`，各自独立列表。
- 每条笔记支持新增、编辑（保留 id 与创建时间）、删除、打标签；顶部有搜索、刷新、清空当前层级；底部显示实际文件路径。
- 面板与模型工具、`/note` 读写的是**同一批文件**，界面上改完 `notepad_list` 立刻可见。

配置 `level` 决定哪几个标签页可用（`global` / `project` / `both`），被禁用的那一页会置灰提示。

## 配置

写在补丁条目的 `config:` 下，或由设置界面编辑（`dsh --dump-config-schema` 能看到）：

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | `global` \| `project` \| `both` | `both` | 本部署暴露哪些层级 |
| `defaultScope` | `global` \| `project` | `project` | 调用省略 `scope` 时的落点 |
| `dshHome` | string | `''` | 全局层根目录；空 = `$DSH_HOME`，再退到 `~/.dsh` |
| `globalDir` | string | `''` | 覆盖全局笔记目录（支持 `~`），空 = `<dshHome>/notepad` |
| `projectDir` | string | `''` | 覆盖项目笔记目录（支持 `~`），空 = `<项目根>/.dsh/notepad` |
| `fileName` | string | `notes.jsonl` | 笔记文件名（只接受纯文件名） |
| `projectRootMarkers` | string[] | `['.git','.hg','.svn']` | 向上查找项目根的标记；`[]` 表示工作目录即项目根 |
| `maxNotes` | integer | `1000` | 单文件上限，超出丢弃最旧；`0` = 不裁剪 |
| `maxContentLength` | integer | `4000` | 单条正文字符上限 |
| `defaultLimit` | integer | `20` | 列表默认条数 |
| `toolPrefix` | string | `notepad` | 工具名前缀（合法值才会被采纳） |
| `enableCommand` | boolean | `true` | 是否注册 `/note` |

```yaml
# 只要全局笔记（只改设置项的写法；已用 dsh plugin add 装好时不要 insert，按 - id: notepad 覆盖该行）
- insert:
    - id: notepad
      name: dsh-plugin-notepad
      config:
        level: global
        defaultScope: global
```

注意 patch 会替换整行的 `config`（不是深合并），所以要重述你需要的每一个键。

## 存储

| 层级 | 默认路径 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `global` | `<DSH_HOME>/notepad/notes.jsonl` | 跨项目共享，比如「我的偏好」「常用命令」 |
| `project` | `<项目根>/.dsh/notepad/notes.jsonl` | 只属于当前项目 |

项目根 = 从会话工作目录向上查找最近的 `.git` / `.hg` / `.svn`；找不到就用会话工作目录本身。默认**不把 `.dsh` 当项目根标记**——DSH home 本身就是 `<home>/.dsh`，否则用户主目录下任何路径都会判定为「项目根 = 主目录」，项目笔记会静默混进全局文件。

每行一条 JSON，追加写；单条解析失败的行会被跳过而不是让列表整体失败：

```json
{"id":"p-mv6ieauq-01fmiy","at":"2026-10-13T09:59:19.922Z","scope":"project","tags":["errand"],"content":"remember the milk"}
```

写入按**笔记文件**串行（而不是按 store 实例），两个 store 落到同一文件时也不会互相覆盖或写出半行；改写与 `maxNotes` 裁剪都先写临时文件再 rename。

## 项目结构

```
dsh-plugin-notepad/            # 仓库根就是插件包根（dsh plugin add github: 要求如此）
├─ package.json                # name / exports / dsh.bundle + dsh.client
├─ cordis.patch.yml            # 组合包贡献的配置层
├─ lib/index.js                # 宿主半入口：name / inject / Config / apply + HTTP 路由
├─ lib/store.js                # 存储层：路径解析、JSONL 读写、编辑/删除、裁剪、并发串行化
├─ lib/api.js                  # 面板用的 JSON API（纯处理函数，可单测）
├─ lib/client.js               # 浏览器半：手写的经典脚本，无需编译
├─ test/                       # node:test 单元测试
└─ scripts/                    # install-notepad.mjs / smoke-runtime.mjs / dev-link.ps1
```

宿主半按 DSH 内置插件的形状写，只用**具名导出**（`name` / `inject` / `Config` / `apply`），不提供 `export default`；`peerDependencies` 统一写成 `"*"`，避免被具体宿主运行时版本判定不兼容而拒绝挂载。

## 开发

```powershell
# 让本仓库的 bare import（@deepseek-ai/schemastery、@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools）能解析
powershell -File scripts\dev-link.ps1

# 单元测试 + 端到端冒烟
node --test
node scripts\smoke-runtime.mjs
```

`dev-link.ps1` 只在 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai` 建一个指向 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai` 的 junction，不复制、不安装任何包。插件装进 profile 后不依赖它。

新增浏览器半需要重启一次应用（`clientModules` 缓存包元数据）；之后只改 `lib/client.js` 会被 client-hmr 热重载。宿主半的新代码会命中 Node 模块缓存，需重启才加载。

## 发布

1. **加话题**：仓库页 About → Topics 加 `dsh-plugin`（或 `gh repo edit --add-topic dsh-plugin`），仓库会出现在 [github.com/topics/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) 下。
2. **发 npm**：仓库根执行 `npm publish`。纯 JS、无构建步骤，`files` 已列出 `lib`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`README.md`、`LICENSE`。
3. **从 GitHub 装**：`dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:qux-bbb/dsh-plugin-notepad`。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Permanent session removal for DeepSeek Harness. Adds Delete session... to the sidebar and removes the log, projection cache, and workspace accounting instead of archiving. Community plugin, not official.
plugins.readme_text:
**Archive hides a conversation. Delete removes it.** COMMUNITY PLUGIN  ·  NOT OFFICIAL  ·  MIT  ·  DSH 0.2.x

[Install](#install)  ·  [Use](#use)  ·  [How it works](#how-it-works)  ·  [Safety](#safety-model)  ·  [FAQ](#faq)

> **This is a community plugin, not an official DeepSeek product.** > > Session Delete is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed > by, or supported by DeepSeek AI, and it is not part of DeepSeek Harness. > DeepSeek Harness and DeepSeek are names and marks of their respective owners. > You are installing code that deletes files on purpose. Read > [Safety](#safety-model) first. ## Why this exists DeepSeek Harness archives sessions. Archiving is useful — the row leaves the sidebar, the session can come back — but it is not removal. The compressed log stays under `~/.dsh/sessions/`, the projection checkpoint stays under `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/`, and the workspace keeps accounting for an id you may never open again. Session Delete adds the missing verb. | | Archive | Delete | | --- | --- | --- | | Row leaves the sidebar | ✅ | ✅ | | Conversation log on disk | stays forever | **removed** | | Projection cache | stays | **removed** | | Workspace accounting / pin / archive entry | kept | **removed** | | Can be restored | unarchive | no | Archive is untouched. Delete is a second, explicit choice at the bottom of the same menu, behind a confirmation.

The new entry sits after the shipped actions, behind a hairline.
## Install **Requires [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 0.2.x** (tested on `0.2.1-rc.1`). Desktop and the Web UI are both supported. The repository is the install unit. The npm package inside it is `dsh-plugin-session-delete`; the spec you paste is the GitHub address. ### 1. From the Plugins page (recommended) 1. Open the sidebar and choose **Plugins**. 2. Install a plugin and paste: ```text github:Adolanium/dsh-session-delete ``` 3. Install it. The bundle is enabled by default. 4. Refresh the DeepSeek Harness window (`Ctrl+R` / `Cmd+R`). The browser half is loaded lazily, so the menu entry appears after a reload. No build permission is needed: the package ships plain JavaScript, has no `prepare` script, and has no runtime dependencies. ### 2. With the `dsh` CLI If you boot profiles yourself (Web, headless, or a stopped Desktop), the same spec installs into a named profile: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Adolanium/dsh-session-delete ``` `dsh` appends the bundle to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` because the package declares `dsh.bundle`. Start DeepSeek Harness afterwards, then refresh the window. Pin the install if you want it frozen to this release: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Adolanium/dsh-session-delete#v0.1.0 ``` Remove it with: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-session-delete ``` > Running the CLI against the `desktop` profile while the Desktop app is running > is supported by the profile lock, but the Plugins page is the smoother path > there — it owns the same operation and reports activation status. ### 3. From a checkout (development) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Adolanium/dsh-session-delete.git cd dsh-session-delete pwsh -File scripts/install-dev.ps1 ``` That links the checkout into `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules` and adds the Loader entry to the profile patch (with a timestamped backup). Undo with `scripts/uninstall-dev.ps1`. > The profile reloads configuration live, so a linked package activates without > a restart. HMR does not watch module roots, so **code edits need a restart**. ## Use Open a session row's **⋯** menu and choose **Delete session…**. The dialog names the conversation and explains that the log and its cached projections will be removed. **Delete** performs the removal; **Cancel** leaves everything alone. What happens next depends on the session: | Session state | Result | | --- | --- | | **Cold** — no live Agent owns it | Removed immediately. The row leaves the list; the dialog closes. | | **Live** — open in this app, or a running turn owns it | The dialog explains that the log is still in use and offers **Delete on next start**. | | **Unknown id** | Rejected. Nothing is touched. | ### Delete on next start A live session cannot be pulled out from under its Agent, so the second option queues it instead: - the id is written to `~/.dsh/plugin-session-delete/pending.json`; - the session is archived (best effort) so the row disappears from the default list; - the next DeepSeek Harness start retries the removal, when the write handle is free; - **unarchiving the session cancels its queued removal** — the archive is the visible "pending removal" state. A queued id whose session is already gone is dropped silently. A queued id that is still in use stays queued for the next start. ## What Delete removes For one session id, the Host removes: - **the session directory** under `~/.dsh/sessions///`, including every format generation (`session.vN.jsonl.zstd`) and the lock artifact; - **the projection-cache record** from the `session_projcache` domain, through the domain itself, so an in-memory row cannot survive the delete; - **the workspace accounting slot**, the global pin, and the archive entry. It deliberately leaves: - **attachments** — content-addressed under `~/.dsh/attachments` and possibly shared with other sessions; - **subagent child sessions** — separate ids, hidden from the sidebar by design; delete them individually; - **the SQLite search index**, if your composition uses `dsh-session-query-sqlite` — it reconciles deleted sources on the next search; - **derived rows in other domains** (telemetry, titles) — they are keyed by an id that no longer resolves and are ignored. ## Safety model Deleting a file is easy. Deleting the *right* file while the app is running is the hard part. The plugin is built around four rules: 1. **One writer.** Before touching anything, the Host takes the persistence **write handle** for the session and immediately closes it. A live Agent, another DSH process, or a crashed-but-held lock makes that open fail, and the delete is refused. The handle is the proof of "nobody is using this". 2. **Loopback only.** The route is rejected for non-loopback peers. A present `Origin` must be the Web client's origin or the Desktop shell's `dsh-app://app`; a cross-site `fetch` cannot reach it (JSON content type forces a preflight the route does not answer). 3. **Strict identity.** The id must match `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`, the target directory must be named exactly that id, and it must contain a canonical `session[.vN].jsonl[.zstd]` log. A malformed id cannot address another path. 4. **No surprises.** If the materialized log is not under the configured root, the Host refuses and says so instead of deleting accounting and leaving the log behind. Cleanup failures are logged; the response reports what happened. There is no network access, no telemetry, and no background process. The plugin reads and writes local files through the Host's own services. ## Configuration All fields are optional. Defaults match a stock installation. | Field | Default | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `dshHome` | `$DSH_HOME`, else `~/.dsh` | Data root used to derive the two roots below. | | `sessionsRoot` | `/sessions` | Session persistence root — the `root` of `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl`. | | `storagesRoot` | `/storages` | Storage root used only as a fallback when the `storageDomain` service is absent. | Set these in the profile entry if you run a non-default persistence root: ```yaml - id: session-de

plugins.description: WeChat bridge + phone layout for DeepSeek Harness: chat with your DSH from WeChat (text, images, files, daily digest) and use its web UI on a phone. 微信桥接 + 手机端适配，把 DeepSeek Harness 变成随身可用的 AI 助手
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-phone-bridge **Turn [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) into something you can carry in your pocket** — a WeChat bot that talks to your DSH from anywhere, plus a plugin that reshapes the DSH web UI into a phone-shaped app. [中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Setup guide](docs/SETUP.md) · [**Phone app**](docs/MOBILE-APP.md) · [Pitfalls](docs/PITFALLS.md) · [**Usage boundary**](docs/USAGE-BOUNDARY.md) > ⚠️ **Personal use only.** This is a single-owner tool: one person, one bot, one conversation. It is **not** authorised for public services, group messaging, marketing, harassment, privacy invasion, circumventing platform rules, or operating someone else's account — see [docs/USAGE-BOUNDARY.md](docs/USAGE-BOUNDARY.md). You are solely responsible for how you deploy it.

  

## What's inside Two independent DSH plugins — use either one on its own. ### 1. `dsh-wechat-connect` — WeChat bridge Runs on your server and long-polls the WeChat iLink bot gateway. Text, images, voice and files go both ways, in **one single conversation** with **one single working directory** — the bot serves its owner and nobody else. - **Send the bot a photo** → DSH reads it with vision tools. **Send a document** → DSH opens it. - **Ask for a file** → the model writes `[[send:/abs/path]]` and the bridge uploads it back to the chat. - **Scheduled digest** — at a configured time every day, DSH researches the previous day's world + AI news and pushes it as **both** a chat message and a Word document. - **Self-healing** — the long-poll loop rebuilds itself after any failure, and writes a heartbeat so an external watchdog can catch the "process alive but wedged" case. ### 2. `dsh-mobile-ui` — phone layout for the DSH web UI The shipped web surface is a three-column desktop layout; on a phone the composer hides behind the keyboard, the sidebar crushes the conversation to a sliver, and the settings page wraps every label one character per line. This plugin injects a stylesheet plus a small script through the documented `webserver/index-inject` seam — **no source edits, no dist patching**: | Problem on a phone | What the plugin does | |---|---| | Left icon rail eats 56px, controls are 28px tall | Bottom tab bar, 44px touch targets | | Keyboard covers the composer | Layout height tracks `visualViewport` | | Sidebar squeezes content to 132px | Full-screen conversation drawer that auto-closes on pick | | Settings crushes labels vertically | Full-screen single column, nav becomes a horizontal strip | | Right sidebar opens with no way back | A visible "← back to chat" button | | iOS zooms the page on focus | 16px inputs | | No home-screen app | PWA manifest + PNG icons → **installs as an app** (own icon, full screen, no browser UI) | > 📱 **It also becomes a real phone app** — no APK, no app store: Chrome → "Add to Home screen" gives you a full-screen app icon, and the manifest's `start_url` can point at a short login link so it re-authenticates itself. See [docs/MOBILE-APP.md](docs/MOBILE-APP.md). ## Repository layout ``` packages/ dsh-wechat-connect/ WeChat bridge plugin (iLink gateway) dsh-mobile-ui/ Phone layout plugin (HTTP injection, no source edits) deploy/ systemd/ boot start, crash restart, watchdog, session filing, journald caps scripts/ watchdog + workspace-filing scripts nginx/ reverse proxy + mTLS device-level access example pwa/ manifest example + icon renderer (home-screen app) docs/ SETUP.md zero-to-running deployment guide MOBILE-APP.md installing the web UI as a phone app (PWA) PITFALLS.md 18 hard-won lessons about DSH internals and the WeChat gateway USAGE-BOUNDARY.md personal-use-only terms ``` ## Quick start ```bash # Server with Node 20+ npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh # Drop the plugins into a DSH profile and list them in its bundles — see docs/SETUP.md ``` Minimal profile config (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/wechat/cordis.patch.yml`): ```yaml - id: wechat-connect config: enabled: true sessionProfile: headless workDir: /root/dsh-convos/wechat # one working directory, one session allowFrom: "wxid_your_peer@im.wechat" # your own id only; empty or "*" = anyone schedule: enabled: true time: "06:00" prompt: | [scheduled digest] Research yesterday's world + AI news, write a Word document, summarise it as a chat message, then output [[send:/abs/path]]. ``` Full walkthrough — model API, QR login, reverse proxy with client certificates, keep-alive stack: **[docs/SETUP.md](docs/SETUP.md)**. ## Design notes - **Single owner, single conversation.** The bridge keeps one working directory and one DSH session — the shape the WeChat bot gateway is actually built around. No per-contact machinery to misconfigure. - **No DSH forks or patches.** The phone layout rides the documented index-injection seam; the bridge is a plain DSH plugin. - **Clone, don't move.** When the plugin needs a button in a React-owned subtree (bottom tabs, composer actions), it clones the original node and forwards clicks — React reconciliation is never disturbed. - **Three layers of keep-alive.** systemd restart on crash → in-plugin loop rebuild on failure → external heartbeat watchdog for the wedged-but-alive case. ## Known limits - The bot is a **separate WeChat account**, not you: it only sees messages sent *to it*, and cannot read your personal chats. - It is built for one owner. Keep `allowFrom` set to your own WeChat id so strangers who find the bot get ignored. - Proactive pushes (the digest) need a `context_token` from an inbound message, so you must message the bot once first. - The iLink bot gateway is not a public, versioned API; `channel_version` changes the upload response shape (the code handles both). ## License and usage boundary MIT for the code. Usage is limited to **personal self-hosted use** — see [docs/USAGE-BOUNDARY.md](docs/USAGE-BOUNDARY.md).

plugins.description: DSH 模型探测插件：用已存凭据查询厂商实时模型目录，预览后经官方配置编辑器安全写回。
plugins.readme_text:
# 原生模型列表在线获取 · 0.1.0

透明增强 DSH 原有「设置 → 模型 → 获取可用模型」流程：普通获取立即读取配置和内置目录，只有显式点击「刷新 / 重试」才请求厂商。每个原生编辑器只有一个刷新按钮，打开选择弹窗后移入弹窗。

**没有独立“模型探测”设置页、卡片、手填表或额外的采用/写入流程。** 模型搜索、勾选、添加和保存仍由 DSH 原生界面负责。

## 行为

- 普通获取、挂载和重新打开编辑器只读最新静态配置与内置目录，不解析凭据、不访问网络、不等旧请求。
- 显式刷新才使用已有路由配置和凭据请求实时目录；不以静态目录或旧缓存冒充刷新成功。
- 刷新复用该提供商原有获取动作；保留已有勾选、搜索文本及请求期间的新操作，不自动添加、删除或保存模型。
- 刷新按钮沿用原生按钮样式，请求期间显示忙碌状态并避免重复触发。
- 失败由原生流程和刷新按钮提示报告；保留当前列表与选择，但不声称旧目录是本次刷新结果。
- **静态配置写入保留在原生保存流程中**：勾选、添加并保存后，由官方 ConfigEditor 写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，不是仅把结果放进在线列表或缓存。
- 原生添加逻辑丢弃的 `reasoningEfforts` 会在官方保存锁内补齐；只补用户已选模型的缺失字段，保留现有顺序、容量、兼容配置、手工推理设置及其他路由。
- 思考能力按具体模型和实际协议映射，覆盖 Codex/OpenAI、Moonshot、xAI、Anthropic、Google、Mistral 和 OpenRouter。区分真实 effort、预算档位、开关、强制思考、明确不支持与未知；未知不写成 `false`，`ultra` 不冒充受支持档位。
- 普通保存无需先刷新即可补齐已确认的内置能力；手工映射、显式删除及自定义 serializer 配置保持优先。
- Gemini 4 Argon 的官方 LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH 需配套可逆请求修正，避免旧适配器把三档都发成自动预算。只作用于官方 Google 路由及精确型号，不改安装包、模型 ID、认证或重试。禁用插件也会卸载此修正；静态配置不会自行删除。
- 模型 ID、容量和模态来自厂商、已安装目录或明确核验的官方资料。Argon 依据 [官方模型说明](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-4-argon) 与 [思考参数文档](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/thinking?hl=en)；用户既有容量不会被覆盖。
- 本地 Qwen 等自定义兼容服务，在未确认后端和聊天模板前不虚构多档能力。仅凭模型名称或 `reasoning: true` 不足以证明支持特定参数。

## 协议与安全

支持 Google Generative AI、OpenAI completions/responses、OpenAI Codex OAuth、Anthropic Messages 和 OpenRouter 的模型列表接口。Codex 读取已有有效登录记录，请求官方 `backend-api/codex/models`；不刷新或改写 OAuth 登录记录。

凭据只在 Host 内解析并发往当前路由配置的服务地址，前端不接收 key、token 或 account ID。保留凭据隔离、响应大小限制、超时、取消、禁止凭据重定向等检查。未授权的草稿地址/协议变更不能继承已存凭据。

只取一页；列出某个模型不等于已验证账号的实际推理权限。请求只获取目录，不发起模型推理。

## 使用与启用

1. 在 DSH 原生模型页配置该提供商的凭据或完成登录。
2. 确认本插件已启用。配置明确设置 `model-probe.disabled: true` 时，不会执行在线增强逻辑。
3. 在原生模型卡片点击「获取可用模型」，在原有弹窗搜索、勾选或点击「刷新 / 重试」。
4. 是否添加和保存始终由用户通过原生界面决定。

包名为 `dsh-live-model-probe`，仓库名为 `dsh-model-probe`。不要安装 npm 上其他作者的 `dsh-model-probe`。本地开发可将本仓库以 `link:` 形式登记为依赖。安装或改变插件启用状态须获得用户明确授权；插件不会自行启用自己。

## 开发与验证

```powershell
node --test test/*.test.mjs
```

普通 Node 测试覆盖零 I/O 静态发现、显式在线刷新、凭据隔离、全协议能力映射、原生保存、真实适配器离线序列化、单按钮迁移、重复点击保护、选择/搜索及请求中编辑保留、无额外页面和卸载清理。实际 DSH 集成测试须显式设置 `DSH_MODEL_TEST_RUNTIME`（DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 + pi-ai 1.1.0 的已解包运行时）和 `DSH_MODEL_TEST_ROOT`；离线推理清单测试须设置 `DSH_MODEL_TEST_INVENTORY`。缺少运行时条件时会标记跳过，不能将其算作通过。

可选的 `node scripts/browser-smoke.mjs` 需要安装开发依赖，并显式设置 `DSH_MODEL_TEST_ROOT`（临时输出目录）、`DSH_MODEL_TEST_RUNTIME`（已核对的 DSH 解包目录）。`DSH_MODEL_TEST_DEPS_ROOT` 可指定现有开发依赖目录，`DSH_MODEL_TEST_BROWSER` 可指定 Chrome。该测试使用安装版列表逻辑和 Modal 结构，图标/焦点层使用测试替身，厂商返回为合成数据；不连接用户账号、不冒充当前 GUI 验收。

弹窗增强依赖 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 已核对的原生 DOM 结构（按钮、弹窗标题、候选行、搜索框与 0.2.0 相同）；结构不匹配时保持原生界面，不接管输入或保存流程。新增厂商目录与真实推理权限仍需分别验证。

## 兼容性

- `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 限定 `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`。
- pi-ai 1.1.0 将 Azure 路由从 `azure-openai-responses` 更名为 `azure`。静态目录、原生保存和凭据引用仍可用；`azure-openai-responses` 协议没有可安全读取的在线列表接口，刷新会以 `AZURE_DISCOVERY_UNSUPPORTED` 明确拒绝（改用 `openai-completions` 的路由不受影响）。
- `.model-probe-cache/catalogs.json` 现为 v3，带 DSH/pi-ai 兼容纪元与 pi-ai 目录代次；旧 v2/旧纪元缓存只读忽略，不会进入原生保存。
- 备份文件保持 v1 结构，但新备份写入 `compat` 标记；升级前（无标记）的旧备份仍可列出，恢复会被 `LEGACY_BACKUP_UNSAFE` 明确拒绝，避免静默丢失 reasoningEfforts 或写入过期容量。

plugins.description: 以证据为准的代码审阅插件：审 diff、验证结论、记录噪音，让 agent 先读、人只读结论。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-review

[English](README.en.md)

提交代码前，让独立审阅者找出具体缺陷，再交给另一组审阅者复核。你看到的是经过验证的问题、明确的未完成项和仍需人工决定的事。

参考 [Claude Code 团队的审阅流程](https://claude.dev/blog/solving-code-review-at-anthropic/)，实现其中可在 DSH 内完成的审阅环节。它不授予人工批准，也不会自动发评论或合并代码。

## 使用

需要 Git、Node.js 22.19+ / 24+，以及提供子智能体、权限预设和作业管理服务的官方 DSH 运行环境。适配验收使用 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1。在 Git 仓库根目录创建会话后，让 DSH：

> 审阅当前改动，运行 dsh-review。只报告有具体触发条件、代码证据和独立复核的问题。审查没完成时不要说通过。

安装到 Web profile：

~~~bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @stardustlc/dsh-review
~~~

桌面版应安装到它实际使用的 profile，并在新的会话中加载插件。插件不会查找、复制或修改其他 profile 的密钥。

请使用带作用域的包名。npm 上未加作用域的 dsh-review 属于其他作者，不是本仓库。

常见调用：

~~~json
{"tool":"review_run","arguments":{"base":"main"}}
~~~

省略 base 审当前工作区；staged=true 审暂存区。需要中断后续工作时取消正在运行的工具；恢复未完成审查时使用返回的 runId。敏感改动始终使用 deep，不能通过参数降级。

## 审阅如何完成

| 模式 | 独立找问题 | 每个问题的复核 | 汇总 |
|---|---|---|---|
| quick | 正确性、安全，2 个任务 | 1 个独立审阅者 | 确定性把关 |
| standard | 正确性、状态、兼容性、安全，4 个任务 | 3 人投票，至少 2 票一致 | 确定性把关 |
| deep | 同 standard | 3 人投票，至少 2 票一致 | 另派汇总者，不能删掉已确认的问题 |

每轮还有两个独立风险判断任务，分别判断风险等级和是否需要额外人工审阅。所有任务使用新的上下文；继承作者对话的 fork 后端不会被接受。

- 每轮绑定 Git 基准、HEAD、完整文件快照和唯一运行编号。代码变化、结果缺失、格式损坏或超限都会阻止放行。
- 复核必须说明具体成因并引用快照中的真实代码行。一个非空 evidence 字符串不算验证。
- 风格、命名、格式和清理建议直接过滤。已发表问题按指纹去重；每条仍须修复或写明处置原因。
- 默认最多 3 轮。从第 3 轮起，新问题限定在相对上轮的实际新增改动；旧问题继续复核，新文件不会漏掉。
- 只有独立复核确认问题已消失，才能自动记为 fixed。人工说明 wrong、intentional 或 wontfix 会保留理由，但不计作人工批准。
- 只生成作业书的外部模式可用于协作，无法证明执行独立性，因此不会通过自动门禁。

二进制变更需要另行验收，文字审查不会认证其内容。跳过的路径会公开列出，并仍参与风险判断。

## 十个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| review_diff | 生成快照与审阅计划，不作通过结论 |
| review_run | 执行或恢复分阶段独立审阅 |
| review_report | 提交外部任务的运行编号、目标编号与 JSON 结果 |
| review_check | 经宿主受控终端运行检查，保存本轮证据收据 |
| review_respond | 记录带理由的处置；fixed 必须重新复核 |
| review_status | 查看未完成项、轮次、调用量和处置噪音率 |
| review_gate | 检查当前快照的 AI 审阅层，不代替 CI 或人工批准 |
| review_learn | 从已验证修复中生成规则草稿，不自动改项目规范 |
| review_issue | 生成 issue 分诊和复现草稿，不执行正文指令或发表评论 |
| review_eval | 登记人工标注缺陷与干净样本、准备盲测、绑定运行结果并计分 |

## 检查、权限与证据

review_check 的命令经调用者实际使用的宿主终端工具运行，不直接创建绕过权限的进程。只读会话不运行证据命令；可使用静态源码复核。取消、超时和后台作业清理都受宿主管理。

Windows 官方预设只提供 pwsh 时，通过这个受控工具调用 Git Bash；需要 Git Bash 和 PowerShell 7.3+。原命令保留可见，引号不经 cmd 拼接。不能使用这条路径时会明确报错，不会静默换成直接执行。

证据收据绑定 runId 和 targetId；命令改变代码后收据失效。请正常批准必要权限，不要为了审阅扩大整个会话的权限。

## 接入仓库流程

仓库级 REVIEW.md 可以写失败判据、跳过路径、敏感目录和噪音上限：

~~~markdown
## 限制
max_nits: 0
severity_floor: important

## 跳过
- vendor/**

## 坏掉长什么样
- 文档给出的命令不能执行
- 配置将请求发送到错误账号

## 敏感路径
- src/billing/**
~~~

完整 PR 门禁还需独立的 CI、安全检查、人工批准和所有审阅线程的解决状态。新增命令 dsh-review-gate 只读取 GitHub 证据，策略固定从 PR 基准提交读取；机器人、旧提交和已撤回的批准不能填人工名额。

详见 [接入与回滚](docs/INTEGRATION.md)、[文章对应边界](docs/DESIGN.md) 和 [验证记录](docs/VALIDATION.md)。合并队列、功能开关、灰度和回滚由仓库/发布系统负责，安装插件不会自动启用这些制度。

## 状态与配置

默认状态保存在 DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-review/<仓库摘要>/，不写入被审项目。可指定仓库内子目录，例如 .dsh-review。账本版本为 2；旧账本会保留备份，旧版本的“通过”不会沿用。

| 配置 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| stateDir | @profile | profile 下按仓库隔离；也可指定仓库内子目录 |
| roundCap | 3 | 每个审阅系列的完成轮次上限 |
| diffOnlyAfterRound | 2 | 超过这轮后只对新增改动提出新问题 |
| maxFindings / maxNits | 20 / 2 | 问题数与 nit 上限 |
| severityFloor | important | 默认不发表 nit |
| maxCalls / maxParallel | 80 / 3 | 每轮实际派发预算、最大并发 |
| runTimeoutMs | 600000 | 每次执行的总超时 |
| commandTimeoutMs | 120000 | 单条证据命令超时 |
| maxDiffBytes | 4194304 | 补丁及源码快照总量上限；超出则未完成 |
| subagentProvider | spawn | 必须明确保证不继承作者上下文 |

evidenceRequired 为旧配置兼容项，设为 false 也不能关闭独立证据验证。v0.2 的手工 head/findings 提交接口已停用，迁移见接入文档。

欢迎提交 [Issues](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/issues) 和 PR，最好附具体触发输入、版本、预期结果与实际结果。请先去掉密钥和私有代码。

[更新记录](CHANGELOG.md) · MIT License

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 同步与备份插件：通过 WebDAV 同步常用配置和 API Key，自动备份，并可预览、恢复历史配置。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Sync · 同步与备份

DeepSeek Harness 的跨设备配置同步与备份插件。通过自己的 WebDAV 存储同步常用配置、保留历史快照，并在需要时预览和恢复。

适用于 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2**。目前支持 WebDAV，暂不支持 S3、GitHub 存储。

## 快速开始

1. 在 DeepSeek Harness 中打开 **插件管理**，点击 **添加插件**。
2. 在“输入插件的包名、GitHub 仓库地址或本地目录路径”输入框中，填写下面任意一种：

   **npm 包名（推荐）：**

   ```text
   @jeweis/dsh-sync
   ```

   **GitHub 仓库地址：**

   ```text
   https://github.com/jeweis/dsh-sync
   ```

3. 点击 **安装**。安装完成后，在 **已安装插件** 中打开 **同步与备份** 右侧的启用开关。npm 包名使用所选安装源；刚发布的包若在镜像源找不到，可切换为 **npm 官方源**。GitHub 安装需要能访问 GitHub，并按 Harness 提示授权源码构建。

## 在哪里使用

安装并启用后，点击 DeepSeek Harness 左下角 **更多 → 设置 → 同步与备份**。

页面分为 **连接存储、同步到其他设备、备份与恢复** 三个页签，每次只显示一项任务。可以连接 WebDAV、选择同步内容、开启自动备份、查看备份记录和恢复预览。超时、检查间隔等参数放在各部分的“更多设置”中，通常不用调整。无需编辑 YAML，也无需先运行终端命令；只有凭据扩展接入/回退与完整恢复需要按页面指引离线确认。

插件安装完成后，跨设备同步、API Key 同步和自动备份均需自行开启。

## 连接两台设备

在两台设备上分别安装插件，然后：

1. 在 **连接存储** 填写相同的 **WebDAV 文件夹地址**，然后开启 **同步到其他设备 → 开启自动同步**。
2. 在 **选择同步内容** 中选择需要的项目，点击 **保存设置**。“更多同步设置”中的 **同步分组** 通常保留 default，两台设备一致即可。
3. 在“同步状态”输入相同的 **两台设备共用的同步口令**，点击 **解锁并检查更新**。口令须为 12–1024 个字符，且与 WebDAV 密码不同。
4. 首次连接时核对差异：第一台设备点击 **使用本机设置开始同步**；新设备点击 **接收云端设置**。也可展开逐项比较；本机独有内容会保留。

之后默认每 **3 分钟**核对一次，也可手动点击“立即同步”。两台设备同时修改同一项时会提示选择，不会直接以最后上传者覆盖另一端。

| 内容 | 当前支持方式 |
| --- | --- |
| 主题、字体、字号和界面语言 | 支持的字段可自动同步并在线生效 |
| 默认模型及部分 DeepSeek 参数 | 支持的字段可自动同步并在线生效 |
| 供应商 API Key | 单独开启，仅加密同步，接收方式见下文 |
| 插件清单 | 显示差异，需要在 Harness 中手动安装或移除 |

同步作用于**当前运行的配置**（如 web 或 desktop），与“要备份的配置”独立选择。不同用途的配置请使用不同同步分组。会话、附件、OAuth 登录状态、MCP/技能文件和任意第三方插件配置不在当前同步范围内。

## API Key 不想重复填写？

在两台设备分别开启 **同时同步 API Key**。支持 DeepSeek 与 pi-ai 中已绑定的 API Key；两端需先有对应的供应商配置，插件不会自动创建供应商。

- **受支持的 Key 记录**：可自动双向同步。
- **引用型 Key**（如供应商使用 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`）：默认只加密上传，接收端提示在 Harness 手动配置。要让新设备自动接收、避免重复填写，请在 **更多同步设置 → API Key 自动接收设置** 中预览接入。

高级接入先预览变更，再按页面指引停止共享凭据存储的全部 Harness 进程，在终端确认切换并重启。**退出仅发生在接入、回退或完整恢复时，日常同步和备份无需退出。** 接入可安全回退，并保留接入后更新的 Key。步骤见 [API Key 自动接收指南](docs/provider-onboarding.md)。

API Key 同步默认关闭，始终加密，不受备份加密开关影响。页面不显示 Key；缺失的 Key 不会清空另一台设备的 Key。

## 历史备份

在 **备份与恢复** 点击 **立即备份**，输入加密口令后点击 **开始备份**。要调整配置范围、保留份数或加密方式，展开 **更多备份设置**。备份包含插件依赖清单、profile 配置补丁及存在的锁文件，不包含凭据文件、会话、附件或已安装的 `node_modules`。

- **自动备份**：可开启配置变更后自动备份；默认等配置稳定 30 秒，两次尝试至少间隔 5 分钟。
- **保留数量**：默认保留本设备最近 **30 份**。仅在新备份校验成功后清理本设备有归属记录的旧快照，不清理其他设备快照。
- **加密**：默认开启。可明确选择明文备份，但配置里直接填写的秘密值也会随文件明文保存。

加密口令需自行妥善保管，丢失后无法恢复加密数据。手动操作不保存口令；自动备份和同步的解锁仅对当前 Harness 进程有效，重启后需要重新解锁。

## 在新设备上恢复

1. 在新设备安装并启用插件，连接与旧设备相同的 WebDAV 文件夹，点击 **保存设置**。页面会查找已有备份。
2. 在 **备份与恢复** 点击 **恢复备份**，选择备份，输入这份备份的加密口令，再点击 **检查并预览恢复**。
3. 核对恢复内容；备份含多份配置时，选择其中一份。它将恢复到当前运行的配置，例如将旧设备的 desktop 配置带到新设备的 desktop。默认保留新设备已安装的插件版本和额外插件；所选配置的插件设置会被替换。
4. 若缺少插件，可点击 **检查 npm 版本**。核对名称和版本后，点击 **确认安装此版本**，由 Harness 安装，再重新检查。旧设备的本地插件需要先在新设备安装可信副本；不能把旧路径直接带过来。构建授权仍遵循 Harness 提示。
5. 检查通过后点击 **生成离线恢复步骤**，然后 **复制恢复命令**。此时只在本机加密暂存恢复任务，尚未替换配置文件。
6. 退出使用该配置位置的全部 Harness 窗口和后台进程，在系统终端运行复制的命令。输入口令（不会回显），核对变化并输入 **确认恢复**，再重新打开 Harness 检查。

只需运行一条命令，无需设置环境变量、复制确认码或再次连接 WebDAV。终端会重新检查文件；若准备后配置又有修改，会停止并要求重新预览。恢复前会保留加密回退副本。

新设备向导不会导入旧设备的锁文件、安装脚本、包管理策略或全局配置补丁；会保留本机启动方式。它恢复配置与插件清单，**不包含聊天记录或凭据文件**。API Key 仍通过独立、默认关闭的加密同步功能接收，不会因恢复备份而自动开启。

如需逐文件原样还原，在 **恢复备份** 向导中展开 **高级：原样还原配置文件**。这里仍使用原来的预览、确认码和离线 CLI 流程。这里的“离线”指**停止相关 Harness 进程，不是断开网络**。回退和中断处理见 [恢复说明](docs/development.md#回滚与中断恢复)。

## 常见问题

**测试连接成功，为什么备份失败？** 测试只确认目录读取情况，写入和创建子目录还需要额外权限。填写 WebDAV 对外的共享目录路径，勿直接使用 NAS 内部磁盘路径；缺失目录会在备份时尝试逐级创建。

**关闭设置页后还会同步吗？** Harness 进程仍运行时会继续；退出 Harness 后停止，不会创建系统登录启动项。

**能使用 HTTP 吗？** 支持 HTTP 和 HTTPS。HTTP 会暴露连接上的 WebDAV 用户名和密码，优先使用 HTTPS。数据加密不等于连接加密。

**同步为什么暂停？** 先查看是否需要解锁、首次比较或处理冲突。设备同步要求 WebDAV 支持强 ETag 和条件写；不支持时仍可使用普通备份。

## 更多说明

- [双设备同步与支持范围](docs/device-sync.md)
- [自动备份](docs/automatic-backup.md) · [快照保留策略](docs/retention.md)
- [版本兼容与改名说明](docs/compatibility.md) · [品牌与数据兼容](docs/branding.md)
- [开发、CLI 与验收说明](docs/development.md) · [维护者发布流程](docs/publishing.md)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-fs-search-plus

增强 DSH 内置的 `glob` / `grep`。不替换工具，不改变结果的格式和上限。

DSH 自带的两个搜索工具用内置 ripgrep，参数是固定的。这个插件在参数表里加字段，并在发起搜索时把字段翻译成 ripgrep 参数。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:RicardoYan/dsh-fs-search-plus#v0.1.0
```

Web 端把 `desktop` 换成你的 profile 名（一般是 `web`）。装完重启 DSH。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-fs-search-plus`

装完不用配置，所有行为通过工具参数控制。

## `glob`

- **返回最新的在前**。原来按修改时间**升序**排，而结果只保留前 100 条，所以拿到的是**最旧的 100 条**。现在改为降序，和工具自己的描述一致。
- **扫描快得多**。原来的排序参数会让 ripgrep 退化成单线程；去掉后正常并行，排序在插件里做。不管命中多少条都照常排序。
- **默认跟随符号链接和 Windows junction**（新增 `follow` 参数）。

## `grep`

新增这些参数，都不传就等于原来的行为：

| 参数 | 类型 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `follow` | boolean | 跟随符号链接，**默认 `true`** |
| `ignoreCase` | boolean | 忽略大小写 |
| `after` | number | 每个匹配后附几行 |
| `before` | number | 每个匹配前附几行 |
| `context` | number | 前后各附几行 |
| `type` | string | 只搜某一种文件类型，如 `ts`、`py` |

`after` / `before` / `context` 没有上限：ripgrep 会按文件长度自然截断，超出工具单次输出上限时会明确报错。

## 要注意的三点

**上下文行看起来和匹配行一样。** 打开 `after` / `before` / `context` 后，附带的行也显示成 `Line N: <文本>`，并且计入 "Found N matches"。这是为了让它们真的能被看到——工具原本会丢弃这类行，只加参数不显示任何东西。

**`follow` 会把链接里的文件也搜进来。** 如果仓库用 pnpm，`node_modules` 里的依赖包本身是链接，跟着走会让结果大很多；对 `glob **/*` 这种全量查询，可能超出工具单次输出的上限而报错。遇到就收窄 `pattern`，或传 `follow: false`。

**树里有断链时也能正常返回结果。** 跟随链接后，任何一个断链都会让底层工具把整次搜索判为失败；插件只在这种情况把结果救回来。搜索目录不存在、正则写错仍然照常报错。

## 适用版本

`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`。依赖 DSH 的内部接口，改用其他版本前先确认。

## 许可证

MIT
